3.3: Muaki lufueti zaba ti mu bilumbu bi tsuka minsekinini miela kuiza, miela diatila mu mvuezolo boso buididi zitsatu ziawu. Miela tuba
3.4: “A kuevi kuidi tsila yi ndizulu andi bila tona bakulu bafua bima bioso bidi vana vawu ; vana thonono yi ntoto.”
3.5: Bila batidi zimbakala mu luzolo diambu diadi : mu thama Nzambi wuvangila diyilu ayi ntoto mu Mambu mandi ; ntoto beni wutotukila mu nlangu ayi wuvangulu mu nlangu.
3.6: Ntoto wu thangu yina wubungu mu thangu nlangu wudiamisa ntoto beni.
3.7: Vayi diyilu ayi ntoto bi thangu yayi bilembo lundu kuidi mambu mandi muingi biba yekolo ku mbazu. Bilembo lundu mu diambu di lumbu ki tsambusu ayi lumbu ki bunga batu bankambu kinzikanga Nzambi.
3.8: Vayi baki luzolo bama, lubika zimbakana diambu diadi : kuidi Pfumu lumbu kimosi kidi banga mili di mimvu ayi mili di mivmu midi banga lumbu kimosi.
3.9: Pfumu kalendi zingila ko mu dedikisa tsilulu andi banga bueta yindudila batu bankaka. Vayi wulembo kuluvibidila bila kakadi zola ti wumosi kabungana. Vayi wuntomba ti baboso babalula mavanga.
3.10: Muaki lumbu ki Pfumu kiela kuiza banga muivi ayi mu lumbu kina diyilu diela zimbala mu biyoko bingolo ayi bima bi diyilu biela siuta mu mbazu ; ntoto ayi mavanga madi muawu mela tumbu zinisu.
3.11: Bu didi ti bima bioso bifueti suita, buna phila batu mbi lufueti ba e ? Lufueti ba batu ba khadulu yinlongo ayi beti kinzikanga Nzambi
3.12: bu lulembo vingila lumbu ki Nzambi ayi bu lulembo tudi nsualu muingi kivika fuana. Mu lumbu kina diyilu diodi dilema mbazu diela suita ayi bima bi diyilu biela suita mu mbazu.
3.13: Vayi banga buididi tsilꞌandi, beto tulembo vingila diyilu dimona ayi ntoto wumona ; kuna kuidi busonga.
3.14: Diawu bakiluzolo bama, bu lumvingilanga mambu momo buna bika lunuana muingi kalubata mu ndembama batu bakambulu ditona ayi tsembolo va ntualꞌandi.
3.15: Lufueti sudika bumbote ti mvibudulu yi Pfumu yawu luvulusu lu batu banga bu lusonikina Polo, khombꞌeto wu luzolo, boso buididi nzayilu yoyo bamvana.
3.16: Wuvanga buawu mu minkanda miandi mioso momo kayolukila mambu momo. Muaki, bukiedika, bitina binkaka phasi bidi mu sudika ; biawu biobi bakambulu diela ayi bakambulu bakinda bumbote balembo balula tsundu banga bu beti vangila mu masonoko mankaka mu diambu di mbivusu yawu veka.
3.17: Diawu, beno bakiluzolo, lukizabidila mambu mama. Lukeba tala bu luvitumunu mu nzimbala yi batu bambimbi, luedi lebakana mu kinda kueno kuidi yeno.
3.18: Vayi luyunduka mu nlemvo ayi mu nzayilu yi Pfumu eto ayi Mvulusi Yesu Klisto. Bika nkembo wubanga yandi tona buabu nate mu zithangu zioso. Ameni !

1.1: Polo, Sila ayi Timote bafidisidi nkanda kuidi dibundu di basi Tesalonika, mu Nzambi, dise dieto ayi mu Pfumu Yesu Klisto.
1.2: Bika nlemvo ayi ndembama bi Nzambi dise dieto ayi bi Pfumu Yesu Klisto bibanga yeno.
1.3: Zikhomba, tufueti vutudilanga Nzambi matondo mu zithangu ziosomu diambu dieno bila buawu bobo bufueni bila minu kieno kilembo kudi buwombo ayi luzolo lueno, lolo luidi mu beno na beno, lueka luwombo.
1.4: Diawu beto mamveto tulembo kukiniemisa mu diambu dieno mu mabundu ma Nzambi mu diambu di mvibudulu eno ayi mu diambu di minu kieno mu zinzomono zioso ayi mu ziphasi zioso lulembo moni.
1.5: Vayi ziawu zidi dimbu kimmonisa ti nzenzolo yi Nzambi yidi yisonga muingi lumonika batu bafuana mu diambu di Kipfumu ki Nzambi kioki lulembo monina ziphasi.
1.6: Bila didi diambu disonga kuidi Nzambi mu vutudila ziphasi kuidibatu balembo lumonisa ziphasi ;
1.7: ayi kuluvana beno, lummona ziphasi luvundulu va kimosi ayi beto. Mu thangu Pfumu Yesu kela monika mu diyilu va kimosi ayi zimbasi zi lulendo luandi ;
1.8: ayi mu nlaki wu mbazu bu kela vana thumbudulu kuidi bawu bakambulu zaba Nzambi ayi kuidi bobo bamanga tumukinanga Nsamu wumbote wu Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto.
1.9: Bawu bela tambula thumbudulu yi mbivusu yikayimani va ntuala Pfumu ayi va ntuala nkembo wu zingolo ziandi ko
1.10: bu kela kuiza mu lumbu beni mu kemboso kuidi banlongo bandi ayi mu kikununu kuidi batu boso bobo bawilukila bila kimbangi kietokiwilukulu kuidi beno.
1.11: Diawu diodi tunsambilanga Nzambi eto u diambu dieno mu zithangu zioso muingi Nzambi eto kalumona bafuana mu lutelo lolo kalutedilaayi muingi kadukisa zitsatu, mu lulendo, luzolo lu mambote mandi ayi dukisa kisalu ki minu ;
1.12: mu diambu di dizina di Pfumu eto Yesu Klisto dikemboso mu beno ayi beno mu niandi boso buididi nlemvo wu Nzambi ayi wu Pfumu Yesu Klisto.

2.1: Zikhomba, mu diambu di ndizulu yi Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto ayi mu diambu di kutakana koko tuela kutakana vadi niandi, tukululomba
2.2: mu diambu lubika vika yamusu mu mayindu meno voti lubika mona tsisi mu diambu di mbikudulu, voti tsangu voti nkanda banga ti kuidi beto wubedi ; wulembo tubi ti lumbu ki Pfumu kifueni.
2.3: Mutu kabika nkutu kuluvuna mu diambu dimosi ko bila lumbu beni kilendi kuiza ko tuamina batu baloza malongi ma Pfumu bela monika ayi mutu wu masumu kamonika, mutu wowo wukubukulu ku mbungulu.
2.4: Niandi weti kakidila ayi weti kukiniemisanga va yilu mambu moso mantedolongo Nzambi voti va yilu mambu moso momo meta sambila batu. Wela vuanda muna Nzo Nzambi ayi niandi veka wela kibieka Nzambi.
2.5: Lukadi buela tebuka moyo ti mambu mama mawu ndilukamba bu ndiba kuidi beno ?
2.6: Vayi buabu luzebi diambu mbi dilembo kakidila mu diambu di mutu beni kamonika mu thangu andi.
2.7: Bila matsueki ma masumu malembo sadi. Vayi mutu wowo wulembo kakidila buabu wela tuama vengumunu.
2.8: Buna bosi mutu wu masumu kela monika ; vayi Pfumu Yesu wela kumbunga mu phemo yi munuꞌandi ayi wela kunzimbikisa mu kiezila ki ndizulu andi.
2.9: Mutu wowo wela kuizila boso buididi kisalu ki satana mu phangulu yi bikumu bi phila mu phila ; yi bidimbu ayi mambu manneni matsiminanga ma phila mu phila ma luvunu.
2.10: Wela vanga mambu mambimbi ma phila mu phila diambu di vuna bobobeta zimbala bila bawu bamanga tambula luzolo lu kiedika mu diambu bavuka.
2.11: Diawu Nzambi kaba fidisila lulendo lu ngolo lukuba zimbisa muingi bakikinina mambu ma luvunu.
2.12: Wuvanga buawu mu diambu di sambisa batu bamanga wilukila mambu ma kiedika vayi bamona khini mu wilukila mambu makambulu masonga.
2.13: Beno bakhomba ziozi Pfumu keta zola, beto tulendi vonga ko vutudilanga Nzambi matondo mu zithangu zioso mu diambu dieno bila tona vana thonono Nzambi wulusobula muingi lutambula luvulusu mu bunlongo bu pheve ayi mu minu ki kiedika.
2.14: Mu diambu diodi Nzambi kalutedila mu Nsamu eto wumboti, muingi lutambula nkembo wu Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto.
2.15: Diawu bakhomba, bika lukala bakinda ayi bika lusimbidila malongimomo lulonguka, buba mu mambu meto voti mu minkanda.
2.16: Muaki niandi veka Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto ayi Nzambi Dise dietowutuzola ngolo ayi wutubomba mu mbombolo yika yisuki ayi wutuvana diana di mbote mu nlemvo andi ;
2.17: babomba mintima mieno ayi balukindisa mu mavanga moso mamboteayi mu thubulu yoso yi mbote.

3.1: Bosi, beno bakhomba, lutusambidilanga mu diambu di mambu ma Pfumumamuangana mu nsualu ayi makemboso banga bu madidi kuidi beno.
3.2: Lutusambidila muingi tukulu mu mioko mi batu batsita ayi bambimbibila baboso basi minu ko.
3.3: Vayi Pfumu wukuikama, niandi wela kulukindisa ayi kulukeba mu mutu wumbimbi.
3.4: Vayi diana tuidi mu Pfumu, mu diambu dieno ti : lulembo vangi ayi luela vanga mambu momo tulutumina.
3.5: Muaki, bika Pfumu kadiatisa mintima mieno kuidi luzolo lu Nzambiayi kuidi mvibudulu yi Klisto.
3.6: Zikhomba, tukulutumina, mu dizina di Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto mu diambu di tatukila, woso-woso kuandi khomba wundiatila mu divunzivayi bika boso buididi malongi momo tunlonga.
3.7: Bila beno veka luzebi mboti buevi lufueti kutusokudila bilatusia diatila ko mu divunzi va khatitsikꞌeno
3.8: voti tusia dia ko mapha ma mutu mu phamba. Bila builu ayi muini tusala mu thovokolo ayi mu ziphasi muingi tuedi singimina kuidi mutu, buna luididi.
3.9: Bika sia ti tusia ba ko minsua vayi tuzola ku lumonisa buevi lulendakutusokudila.
3.10: Bila bu tuba kuidi beno, tulukamba ti : “Woso mutu mengi kuandi sala, buna kabika tomba bidia !”
3.11: Bila tulembo wanga zitsangu ti bankaka mu beno balembo zingila mu divunzi, bamengi kuawu sala, kisalu kiawu kotanga mu mambu ma batu bankaka.
3.12: Tuntumina kuidi batu ba phila yoyi ayi tueti kuba lubula mu dizinadi Pfumu Yesu Klisto ti basala mu ndembama mu diambu badia bidia biawu veka.
3.13: Vayi beno bakhomba, lubika vonga mu vanganga mamboti.
3.14: Enati mutu mengi tumimina mambu tulukamba mu nkanda wawu, luntula dimbu ayi lubika tula yandi kikundi muingi kamona tsoni.
3.15: Muaki lubika kumona banga mbeni vayi bika lunlubula banga khomba.
3.16: Bika niandi veka Pfumu yi ndembama kaluvana ndembama mu zithanguzioso ayi mu zinzila zioso. Bika Pfumu kabanga yeno beno boso.
3.17: Minu Polo ndiluveni mboti mu koko kuama. Buawu bobo ndieti tudilanga dimbu ku tsuka wu kadika nkanda. Bobo ndieta sonikina.
3.18: Bika nlemvo wu Pfumu eto Yesu Klisto wubanga yeno beno boso.

1.1: Polo, mvuala wu Yesu Klisto mu luzolo lu Nzambi, boso buididi tsila yi luzingu yidi mu Klisto Yesu,
1.2: mfidisidi nkanda wawu kuidi Timote muanꞌama wu luzolo. Bika nlemvo, mamboti ayi ndembama bibedi kuidi Nzambi Tata ayi kuidi Klisto Yesu, Pfumu eto, bibanga yaku.
1.3: Ndimvutula matondo kuidi Nzambi yoyi ndieta sadila mu mayindu ma ntima wuvedila banga busila bakulu bama ; bila builu ayi muini ndikutebukilanga moyo, mu zithangu zioso mu zindombolo ziama.
1.4: Phuila yiwombo yidi yama mu kumona, bu ndieti tebukila matsuela maku moyo, muingi ndibuela mona khini.
1.5: Ndizimbakananga ko minu kikiedika kidi mu ngeyo ; ayi kioki kituama ba mu khayꞌaku yi nketo mama Loyisi ayi mu ngudi aku Ewunise. Tsidi diana ti kidi mu ngeyo.
1.6: Diawu ndikutebudila moyo muingi wuluta buela lemisa dikaba di Nzambi didi mu ngeyo ; diodi wutambula bu nditetika mioko miama
1.7: bila Nzambi kasia kutuvana Pheve yi boma-boma ko vayi wutuvana pheve yi lulendo, yi luzolo ayi yi diela di kukikebila.
1.8: Diawu kadi mona tsoni mu telama kimbangi mu diambu di Pfumu eto voti mu diambu diama bu ndidi mu nloko mu diambu diandi. Vayi bika wufubakana yama mu ziphasi mu diambu di Nsamu wumboti boso buididi lulendo lu Nzambi.
1.9: Bila niandi wutuvukisa ayi wututela mu mbila yinlongo ; bika sia ti boso bubela mavanga meto vayi boso bu bela lukanu luandi veka ayi nlemvo andi wowo katuvana mu Klisto Yesu tuamina thonono yi zithangu.
1.10: Vayi buabu wutumonisa wawu bumboti mu ntangu Pfumu eto Yesu Klisto kayiza ; bila niandi wukosikisa lulendo lu lufua, wukienzula luzingu ayi biobi kabifuanga ko mu nzila yi Nsamu Wumbote.
1.11: Mu diambu di Nsamu Wumbo ti beni wawu ndibiekolo nsamuni, mvuala ayi nlongi kuidi Bapakanu.
1.12: Ayi diawu ndilembo monina ziphasi ziazi vayi ndikadi mona tsoni mu diambu nzebi mutu wowo ndiwilukila ayi diana tsidi ti lulendo luidi yandi mu keba mambu moso momo ndiyekudulu nate mu lumbu kina.
1.13: Kebanga bumboti mambu ma kiedika momo wuwa kuidi minu mu minu ayi mu luzolo luidi mu Klisto Yesu.
1.14: Lundanga bumbote, mu lusadusu lu Pheve Yinlongo mu beto, mambu mambote momo wuyekudulu.
1.15: Ngeyo zebi ti batu boso badi mu Azi bandoza, mu bawu muidi Fingele ayi Elimongene.
1.16: Bika Pfumu kawokisa mamboti mandi mu nzo yi Onesifole, bila niandi wuba kumbombanga buwombo ayi kasia mona tsoni ko mu diambu di zisieni ziama.
1.17: Vayi bu kaba ku Loma, wuthomba mu bufula ayi wumbakula.
1.18: Bika Pfumu kamvana diluaku ditambudila mamboti ma Pfumu mu lumbu kina. Ngeyo lutidi zaba phila yoyi katsadisila mu mambu mawombo bu ndiba ku Efeso.

2.1: Diawu ngeyo muanꞌama, bika wukikindisa mu nlemvo wowo widi mu Klisto Yesu.
2.2: Mambu momo wuwa kuidi minu va meso ma bambangi bawombo, longa mawu kuidi batu bakuikama bobo babeki bu kumalongila kuidi batu bankaka.
2.3: Bika wumona ziaku ziphasi banga disodi dimboti di Yesu Klisto.
2.4: Bila kuisi ko mutu wunkuendanga ku mvita wumbelanga mayindu mu bima bi luzingu lualu mu diambu kamonisa khini mutu wowo wunsonika.
2.5: Bobuawu, mutu wunsalanga zitsaka (bipa) kalendi vuiku budu ki ndungunu ko enati kakadi nuana boso buididi mina.
2.6: Nkuni zitsola kafueti tuama sala theti tuamina katambula mimbutu.
2.7: Sudika bumboti mambu mama thubidi bila niandi veka Pfumu wela kuvana diela mu mambu moso.
2.8: Tebukilanga Yesu Klisto moyo, wutotukila mu nkuna Davidi, wufuluka mu bafua boso buididi Nsamu wumboti wundieti longa.
2.9: Bila mu diambu di Nsamu wumboti beni wawu ndilembo monina ziphasi ayi ndididi wukangama banga mvangi mambimbi. Muaki mambu ma Nzambi masi makangama ko.
2.10: Diawu ndilembo kangila ntima mu diambu di batu bobo basobolo muingi bawu mamvawu batambula phulusu yidi mu Yesu Klisto va kimosi ayi nkembo wu kawumani.
2.11: Mambu mama madi ma kuikama :
2.12: Enati tumvibidila
2.13: Enati tuisi ko bakuikama,
2.14: Tebula batu moyo mu mambu momo ; wuba lubula va meso ma Nzambi ti babika ziphaka mu mambu ma phamba makambulu mfunu. Vayi mannatanga ku mbivusu batu bobo banwanga mawu.
2.15: Nuana mu monika va meso ma Nzambi banga mutu wufuana, banga kisadi kikambu mona tsoni ; kinlonga mu busonga mambu ma kiedika.
2.16: Tina ziphaka zi mambu ma phamba ayi makambu dedakana ayi minu bila batu bobo bantubanga mawu beti luta kuendanga mu zithangu zioso ku kambu kinzikanga mambu ma Nzambi
2.17: ayi mambu mawu madi banga phuta yindianga nsuni wu nitu. Mu bawu muidi Imene ayi Filete.
2.18: Bawu bamana vengama mu kiedika bu beti tubanga ti mfulukulu yimana vioka thama ; balembo zimbisa minu ki batu bankaka.
2.19: Muaki fundasio yi ngolo yi Nzambi yidi kaka yitelama ayi yibeki ayi dimbu kiaki : “Pfumu zebi batu bandi, ayi woso mutu weti tangunanga dizina di Pfumu, bika katina mambu mambimbi.”
2.20: Bika sia ti mimvungu mivangulu mu nolo ayi mu palata, ziawu kaka mimmonikanga mu nzo yinneni vayi muidi ayi miomi mivangulu mu minti ayi mu tuma. Miomi mivangulu mu nolo ayi mu palata midi mi luzitu bosi miomi mivangulu mu minti ayi mu tuma miawu minsadulungu kadika lumbu.
2.21: Enati mutu wukikebidi wuvedila mu kambu vanga mambu mama, buna niandi wela kituka mvungu wu luzitu, wunlongo, widi mfunu kuidi vuidi wawu ; wawu widi wukubama mu diambu di mavanga moso mambote.
2.22: Tina zinzinunu zi bumuana vayi tomba busonga, minu, luzolo, ndemama va kimosi ayi batu bobo bansambilanga Pfumu mu ntima wuvedila.
2.23: Tina biuvu bi buvungisi, ayi bikambulu mfunu bila bizabikini ti biawu bieti totula ziphaka.
2.24: Bila kisadi ki Pfumu kasi fuana findananga ziphaka ko vayi kafueti ba mutu wulembama kuidi batu boso, mutu widi diela mu longa ayi mu zebi vibidila.
2.25: Kafueti teminanga mu malembi batu bobo bankakidilanga bila nani zebi mananga Nzambi lenda kuba vana diela di baludila mavanga ayi tula ku nzayilu yi mambu ma kiedika ;
2.26: ayi diela diawu divutukisa mu diambu babaka busionukina mu mintambu mi Satana, wuba kanga mu kuba kuika mu diambu bavanga luzolo luandi.

3.1: Zaba kuaku ti mu bilumbu bitsuka, muela ba zithangu ziphasi.
3.2: Bila batu bela ba buimi, bela ba bakundi ba zimbongo, bela ba luniemo, bela ba lunangu, bela ba mimvuezi mi mambu ma Nzambi, bela ba mitingu kuidi bambuta ziawu, bela zabanga ko vutula matondo, bela zabanga ko ba banlongo ;
3.3: bela ba batu bakambulu luzolo, bakambulu kiadi, bela vunina badiawu mambu, bela zabanga ko kukiyala, bela ba batu batsita ; bela ba bambeni zi mamboti.
3.4: Bela yekulanga badiawu ; bela vika fuemanga, bela kukinangikanga mu luniemo, bela luta zolanga zikhini viokila Nzambi.
3.5: Bela monikanga banga bazebi kinzikanga Nzambi vayi bela tunukanga mambu momo mammonisanga zingolo zi mambu ma Nzambi. Bika wutatukila batu ba phila yoyi.
3.6: Bankaka mu bawu bankotanga mu zinzo ; ayi bambuilanga baketo bakambulu mayindu masikama, ayi bannatanga zitu ki masumu momo bavola ayi bammonanga tsatu yi mambu mambimbi ma phila mu phila.
3.7: Baketo beti longukanga mu zithangu zioso vayi balendi baka bu tudila ku nzayilu yi mambu ma kiedika ko.
3.8: Banga Yanesi ayi Yambelesi bamanga wilukila Moyize, buawu bobo batu beni bamengi wilukila kiedika ; bu badi batu babivusu mu diela diawu ayi minu kiawu kizimbalanga bu kieti toto.
3.9: Balendi kuenda ku ntuala ko bila buvungisi buawu buela monika kuidi batu boso, banga bubela batu ba buadi bobo.
3.10: Vayi kuidi ngeyo, wulandikini malongi mama, khadulu ama, zikhanu ziama, minu kiama ; lembama kuama luzolo luama ayi mvibudulu ama.
3.11: Ngeyo wumona zinzomono ziama ayi ziphasi ziama, phila zimbuidila ku Antioshe, ku Ikone, ku Lisitele. Ayi phila zinzomono mbi ndikambu mona ! Vayi Pfumu wukhula mu zizioso.
3.12: Muaki zaba ti babo bobo batidi zinga luzingu luvedila va meso ma Nzambi, mu lusadulu lu Yesu Klisto, bela zomo.
3.13: Vayi batu bambimbi ayi bankua luvunu bela luta vanganga mambu mambimbi ; bela vuna bankaka ayi bawu veka bavunuka.
3.14: Vayi ngeyo, kangama mu mambu momo wulonguka ayi momo mazabikini ti madi makuikama bu zebi mutu wulonga mawu.
3.15: Tona mu kimuana kiaku, ngeyo zebi Masonuku Manlongo ; mawu malenda kuvana diela di kiedika mu diambu wubaka phulusu mu minu mu Klisto Yesu.
3.16: Masonuku mamo masonimina mu lulendo lu Nzambi, madi mfunu mu longa, mu tubidila, mu ludika ayi longa mu diatila mu busonga,
3.17: muingi mutu wu Nzambi kaba wuduka ayi kaba wukubama mu vanga mavanga moso mamboti.

4.1: Minu ndikutumina va meso ma Nzambi ayi ma Yesu Klisto wela sambisa batu banzinga ayi bafua, mu diambu di bu kela monika ayi mu diambu di Kipfumu kiandi ti
4.2: longa mambu ma Nzambi ayi longa mawu mu bufula mu zithangu zioso, yiba yifuana voti yikambu fuana. Totula luvunu lu batu, temina ayi lubula mu mvibusulu yingolo ayi lubula mu ndongolo.
4.3: Bila thangu yidi yela ba ti batu bakadi buela zola wa malongi ma kiedika ; vayi mu diambu di zitsatu ziawu bela kukivangila minlongi miwombo-wombo, miomi miela kuba kamba mambu momo makutu mawu matidi wa.
4.4: Bela kanga matu mawu mu diambu babika buela wa mambu ma kiedika vayi bela zibula mawu mu diambu di wa zinongo.
4.5: Vayi ngeyo, wukikeba mu mambu moso momo ; vibidila mu ziphasi, sala kisalu kiaku ki kinsamuni ayi manisa kisalu bumboti.
4.6: Bila mu diambu diama ndidi wukubama mu tambuku banga dikaba ayi thangu yi kuendila yizidi.
4.7: Minu ndinueni nduanunu yimboti, ndinakuni zithinu nate kuna tsuka ; ndikebidi minu.
4.8: Buabu nzebi ti ndilundulu budu ki kipfumu ki busonga, kioki Pfumu, zuzi disonga, kela kuphana mu lumbu kina. Bika sia ti kuidi minu kaka vayi wela kivana kuidi baboso bobo banvingilanga mbonokono andi mu luzolo.
4.9: Sia nsualu mu vika kuiza ku ndidi.
4.10: Bila Demasi wundiefudi ; bu kavukumunkini mu landakana nza yayi ayi wuyenda kuandi ku Tesalonika. Kelesensi wuyenda ku Ngalatiya ayi Tite niandi wuyenda ku Dalimati.
4.11: Luka kaka widi yama vava. Bu wu nkuiza vitula Malako, kiza yaku bila mfunu ndimvuidi mu kisalu kiama.
4.13: Bu wunkuiza, buna wundatina yunga ki ndibika mu nzo Kalipusi ku Tolowasi ayi zibuku, buidi ziozi zivangimina mu minkanda mi bibulu.
4.14: Alekisandele, dimfulanga bisengo, wuphangila mambimbi mawombo. Vayi Pfumu wela kumvutudila boso buididi mavanga mandi.
4.15: Mamvaku wukikeba mu diambu diandi, bila niandi wukakidila mu kingolo mambu meto.
4.16: Bu ndisamba mu khumbu yi thete, kadi mutu kasia kutsadisa ko ; babo bathina. Vayi bika babika kuba tangila nzimbala yoyi.
4.17: Pfumu niandi wutelama va ndambu va ndiba ayi wukhindisa mu diambu di mu minu ndongolo yiba yiduka ayi yidukila mu makanda moso nate kuidi Bapakanu. Bukiedika minu ndikulu mu munu wu khosi.
4.18: Nzebi ti Pfumu wela kukhula mu mavanga mamo mambimbi ayi wela kukheba mu diambu di mu Kipfumu kiandi ku Diyilu. Bika nkembo wubanga yandi mu zithangu zioso. Amen.
4.19: Vana mboti kuidi Pilisika ayi Akilasi ayi nzo yoso yi Onesifole.
4.20: Elasite wusiala ku Kolinto ; mu kimbevo ndibika Tolofime ku Mile.
4.21: Tomba bu kuizila tuamina sivu. Ewubulusi, Pudensi, Linusi, Klodia ayi bakhomba zioso zifidisidi mboti.
4.22: Bika Pfumu kabanga mu Pheve aku. Nlemvo wubanga yaku.

1.1: Nkulutu sonikini nkanda wawu kuidi mama diodi disobolo ayi kuidi bana bandi bobo ndieti zola mu kiedika. Bika sia ti minu kaka, vayi, ayi batu boso bobo banzolanga kiedika
1.2: mu diambu di kiedika kidi mu beto ayi kiela kalanga mu beto mu zithangu zioso.
1.3: Bika nlemvo, mamboti ayi ndembama bibedi kuidi Nzambi Tata ayi kuidi Yesu Klisto, Muana wu Tata, bibanga yeto mu kiedika ayi mu luzolo.
1.4: Khini yiwombo ndilembo moni mu mona ti bana baku bankaka bandiatila mu kiedika banga bu tutambudila lutumunu kuidi Tata.
1.7: Bila batu bawombo baluvunu batotukidi va nza. Bawu bakikininangako ti Yesu Klisto wuyiza mu nsuni. Mutu wuntubilanga bobo niandi nkua luvunu ayi antiklisto.
1.8: Diawu lulubuka tala luedi zimbisa mambu momo luvanga vayi muingi lutambula mfutu wuduka.
1.9: Woso mutu wumvambananga ayi kambulu kangama mu malongi ma Klisto, kasi kithuadi ayi Nzambi ko. Vayi woso mutu widi wukangama mu malongi, niandi widi mu kithuadi ki Tata ayi ki Muana.
1.10: Enati mutu wizidi kuidi beno ayi kakadi nata malongi mama bunalubika kunyakula mu nzoꞌeno, lubika kumvana mboti.
1.11: Bila woso wukumvana mboti buna wumfubakananga yandi mu mavanga mandimambimbi.
1.12: Mambu mawombo makidi yama makulusonikina vayi mbengi kubuvangila mu phapi ayi mu thita ; vayi diana ndisia mu kuiza kuidi beno ayi solula yeno zizi mu zizi muingi khini eto yiba yiduka.
1.13: Bana ba khombꞌaku yi nketo yisobolo bafidisidi mboti.
1.5-6: Buabu, mama, tala diambu ndikulomba : bika sia ti lutumunu lumona ndikusonikina vayi lolo kuandi tutambula tona vana thonono. Ayi lutumunu beni banga kuandi bu luwila luawu tona vana thonono ti ludiatila mu luzolo.

1.1: Nkulutu sonikini nkanda wawu. Kuidi kiluzolo kiama Ngayusi, mutu wowo ndieti zola mu kiedika.
1.2: A kiluzolo, lukanu luama luidi mu diambu wutoma nitu mu mambu moso ayi wuba mu buvini banga boso buntomina muelꞌaku.
1.3: Khini yiwombo ndimona bakhomba bu bayiza ayi zitelimina kiedika kiaku kimbangi ayi buevi ngeyo weti diatila mu kiedika.
1.4: Ndikadi mona khini yiviokidi yayi : mu wa ti bana bama bandiatila mu kiedika.
1.5: A kiluzolo, ngeyo widi wukuikama mu mambu moso momo wetivanga mu diambu di bakhomba ; ka diambu ko badi banzenza kuidi ngeyo.
1.6: Zinzenza beni zitelimina luzolo luaku kimbangi va ntuala dibundu.
1.7: Bila bawu bayenda mu diambu di samina dizina di Pfumu mu kambu tambula kadikima kuidi Bapakanu.
1.8: Beto tufueti yakulanga bumboti batu ba phila yoyi muingi tusala va kimosi mu diambu di kiedika.
1.9: Tsonikini ndambu zi mambu kuidi dibundu vayi Diotelefe, mutu wuntomba monikanga wutheti mu bawu, wumanga ku khinzika.
1.10: Diawu, enati ndizidi, ndiela yolukila mavanga momo kalembo vangibu keti tuba mambu mambimbi mu diambu dieto. Bika sia ti mawu kaka mambu keti vanga, vayi niandi veka kayakulanga ko bakhomba, weti kakidika bakhomba ziozi zitidi kuba yakula. Bosi weti kubakukamu dibundu.
1.11: A kiluzolo, kadi sokudilanga mambimbi vayi sokudilanga mamboti. Woso mutu wumvanganga mamboti Nzambi wumvuidi ; woso mutu wumvanganga mambimbi kasia mona Nzambi ko.
1.12: Batu boso banteliminanga Demetelusi kimbangi ayi kiawu vekakiedika kinkuteliminanga kimbangi. Beto mamveto tueti kuntelimina kimbangiayi ngeyo zebi ti kimbangi kieto kidi ki kiedika.
1.13: Mambu mawombo madi yama ma kusonikina vayi mbengi kusonikina mu thita ayi mu lapi.
1.14: Vayi tsidi diana mu vika kumona ; buna bosi tuela solula zizi mu zizi.
1.15: Bika ndemama yibanga yaku. Bakundi badi kuaku bafidisidi mboti. Vana mboti kuidi bakundi badi kuna, kadika mutu mu dizina diandi.

1.1: Mu zikhumbu ziwombo ayi mu zinzila ziwombo, Nzambi wuyolukila mutsi khulu, bakulu beto mu nzila yi mimbikudi.
1.2: Vayi mu bilumbu biabi bi tsuka Nzambi wutuyolukila mu Muanꞌandi, mutu wowo kabieka mvingidi wu bima bioso ayi mu niandi kavangila bima bioso.
1.3: Muana beni wulembo monikisa lezama ku nkembo wu Nzambi ayi niandi mfikula yimonisa bumboti bumutu buandi. Niandi weta kindisa bima bioso mu mambu mandi ma lulendo. Bu kamanisa kubika tsukudulu yi masumu ; buna wuvuanda ku Diyilu va koko ku lubakala lu Nzambi, nkua ngolo yoso.
1.4: Buna niandi wulutila zimbasi mu luvalu bila dizina di katambula dilutidi dizina di zimbasi.
1.5: Muaki kuidi mbasi mbi yoyi Nzambi kakamba :
1.6: Bosi bu kakotisa mutu wutheti wu butuka va nza, wubuela tuba ti :
1.7: Mu diambu di zimbasi, niandi wutuba ti :
1.8: Vayi mu diambu di Muana, niandi wutuba ti :
1.9: Wunzolanga masonga vayi wunlendanga mambimbi.
1.10: Wubuela diaka :
1.11: Biela bungana
1.12: Wela bizinga banga bu nzingulungu nledi
1.13: Ayi kuidi mbasi mbi katuba ti :
1.14: A ziawu zisi ko ziphevi zinsadilanga Nzambi, zifidusu mu diambu di sadila batu bobo bela vinginina kiuka ki phulusu e ?

2.1: Diawu, tufueti luta keba mu mambu momo tuwa, tala tuedi zimbala.
2.2: Bila enati mambu momo zimbasi zisamuna maba makinda ayi enati mbundudulu yi Mina ayi kambu ku tumamana koso kutambula thumbudulu yifuana ;
2.3: buna buevi tulenda vukila enati tulembo lenzi phulusu yoyi yinneni ? Lolo niandi veka Pfumu katuama samuna bosi yikindusu kuidi batu bobo banwa.
2.4: Nzambi wukindisa kimbangi kiawu mu bidimbu, mu mavanga matsiminanga ayi mu bikumu bi phila mu phila ayi mu makaba ma Pheve Yinlongo makabulu boso buididi luzolo luandi.
2.5: Muaki bika sia ti kuidi zimbasi Nzambi kayekudila nza yinkuiza, wowo tulembo yolukila.
2.6: Muaki vadi vama vamosi mutu wumosi, wutelama kimbangi kiaki :
2.7: ngeyo wumvanga mutu wukambu luvalu,
2.8: Ngeyo wutula bima bioso ku tsi bitambi biandi.
2.9: Vayi Yesu, mutu wowo wutuama ba wukambu luvalu mu ndambu thangu zimbasi bu zimviokila mu luvalu, tulembo moni buabu wuvuiku nkembo ayi nzitusu mu diambu di ziphasi zi lufua ziozi kamona mu diambu di nlemvo wu Nzambi bu kafuila batu boso.
2.10: Muaki dimonika ti didi difuana kuidi Nzambi, wuvanga bima bioso ayi wunzingisa bima bioso, mu kitula Yesu mutu wufuana mu nzila yi ziphasi mu diambu di nata bana bawombo ku nkembo andi. Bila Yesu niandi mutu wukubanatanga ku phulusu.
2.11: Bila ayi mutu wowo wumvedisa ayi batu bobo bavedoso, babo mu dise dimosi batotukila. Diawu kamonanga tsoni ko mu kuba tedila bakhomba bandi
2.12: mu thangu kakamba :
2.13: Wubuela diaka :
2.14: Sumbu didi ti bana bafubakana mu menga ayi nsuni buna niandi mamvandi wutumbu fubakana. Wuvanga buawu mu diambu di kosikisa, mu nzila yi lufua, satana, mutu wowo beki lulendo lu lufua,
2.15: ayi mu diambu di kula batu boso bobo baba bavika ba boma bu lufua mu luzingu luawu loso.
2.16: Bila bukiedika kasia kuiza mu diambu di sadisa zimbasi ko vayi wuyiza mu diambu di sadisa nkuna wu Abalahami.
2.17: Mu bila kioki, nganu wutumbu dedakana, mu mambu moso, banga bakhomba muingi kakituka pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yilenda vanga dioso di kazodidi, pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yimmonanga kiadi ayi yikuikama mu kisalu ki Nzambi mu diambu masumu ma batu malemvokolo.
2.18: Bila sumbu niandi veka katoto mu ziphasi zikamona buna wulenda kuandi sadisa babo balembo toto.

3.1: Diawu diodi bakhomba zinlongo, beno lutelo kuidi Nzambi mu baka kuku mu bima bi Diyilu, bika lutadidila Yesu mvuala ayi nganga Nzambi yi minu kioki tulembo samuni.
3.2: Niandi wuba wukuikama kuidi mutu wowo wumbieka banga bu bela Moyize mu nzo yimvimba yi Nzambi.
3.3: Bila Yesu wumono ti widi wufuana mu tambula nkembo viokila wowo wutambula Moyize. Banga kuandi ntungi wu nzo wuntambulanga nzitusu viokila nzo yika tungidi.
3.4: Bila kadika nzo yitungu kuidi mutu ; vayi Nzambi niandi wutunga bima bioso.
3.5: Mu diambu di Moyize, niandi wuba wukuikama mu nzo yi mvimba yi Nzambi banga kisadi mu diambu di telamanga kimbangi mu mambu momo mafueti samunu.
3.6: Vayi Klisto, niandi widi wukuikama banga Muana mu nzo yi Nzambi. Beto tuidi nzoꞌandi enati tunsimbidila nate tsukulu bufula ayi diana di ngolo diodi tueti ku kiniemisina.
3.7: Diawu, banga bueti tuba Pheve Yinlongo ti :
3.8: Lubika kitula mintima mieno banga matadi
3.9: Mu lumbu kina bakulu beno batsoka
3.10: Diawu ndifuemina buwombo tsungi yina ayi ndituba :
3.11: Diawu ku tsi nganzi ama
3.12: Diawu bakhomba, lukeba mu diambu mutu mu beno kabika ba ntima wumbimbi ayi wunkambu wilukilanga ; tala kedi tamba Nzambi yi moyo manima.
3.13: Vayi lulubasananga kadika lumbu beno na beno, bu tuidi ayi “lumbu kiaki” muingi mutu mu beno kabika vunuka mu masumu ayi kabika ba matingu.
3.14: Bila enati tunsimbidila nate kuna tsukulu diana diodi diba yeto vana thonono, buna tuidi mu kithuadi ayi Klisto.
3.15: Banga bu tubulu :
3.16: Buna banani bobo batinguna bu bawa mbemboꞌandi e ? Buna keti babo bobo Moyize katotula mu Ezipite e ?
3.17: Buna banani bobo Nzambi kafuemina mu makumaya ma mimvu e ? Buna keti batu bobo bavola masumu ayi bafua mu dikanga e ?
3.18: Buna kuidi banani Nzambi kalefila ndefi ti balendi kota ko mu luvundulu luandi e ? Buna keti bobo bamanga kuntumukina e ?
3.19: Buna tumueni ti basia nunga ko mu kota mu diambu di kambu kuawu ku minu.

4.1: Sumbu tsila yi kotila mu luvundulu lu Nzambi bu yikidi, bunatukeba tala wumosi mu beno kedi kambu bu kotila.
4.2: Bila beto mamveto, batulonga Nsamu Wumboti, banga batu bana. Vayi mambu bawa masia ku basadisa ko bila masia bundana ko ayi minu ki bawu batambula mawu.
4.3: Bila kuidi beto tuwilukila, tueka kota mu luvundulu banga Nzambi bu katubila ti :
4.4: Bila vama va nkaka vayolokolo mu diambu di lumbu kitsambudi ti : Nzambi wuvunda mu lumbu kitsambudi bu kamanisa kisalu kiandi kioso.
4.5: Ayi mu yo yawu nzila, wutuba ti : balendi kota ko mu luvundulu luama.
4.6: Sumbu didi ti batu bankaka bafueti kota mu luvundulu lolo, vayi batu bobo batuama longo Nsamu wumboti basia kota ko mu diambu di kambu kuawu ku tumama ;
4.7: diawu Nzambi kabuela kubikila Lumbu kinkaka, kintedolo “Lumbu kiaki” bu katuba, bilumbu biwombo bu bivioka, mu Davidi boso butuama yolokolo :
4.8: Bila enati Zosue wuba vana luvundulu nganu Nzambi kalendi buela tubila lumbu kinkaka ko.
4.9: Vayi luvundulu lusiedi kuidi batu ba Nzambi luidi banga lu lumbu ki saba.
4.10: Bila mutu wowo wukota mu luvundulu lu Nzambi, niandi mamvandi wuvunda bu kamanisini kisalu kiandi banga bu vundila Nzambi bu kamanisa kisalu kiandi.
4.11: Tunuana mu kota mu luvundulu beni mu diambu mutu kabika bua mu sokudila kambu ku tumama ku phila yoyi.
4.12: Bila mambu ma Nzambi madi moyo ayi malembo sadi ngolo ; maviokidi sabala mu meno, mankotanga ngolo nate mu vambisa moyo ayi pheve, nate mu vambisa madikulu ayi tonzo tu mimvesi ayi meti fiongunina mayindu ayi makani ma mintima.
4.13: Kuisi ko kadi vangu kimosi kidi kisuama va meso ma Nzambi. Bima bioso bidi va yambi ayi bisi ko bisuama va meso ma mutu wowo wela kutusambisa.
4.14: Diawu bu tubeki pfumu yi zinganga yisabuka Diyilu, Yesu Muana Nzambi, buna bika tusimbidila kimbangi kieto ki minu.
4.15: Bila tuisi pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi ko yoyi yinkambu fubakananga mu ziphasi zieto. Vayi tubeki wumosi wutoto banga beto mu mambu moso, vayi kasia vola kadi disumu dimosi ko.
4.16: Diawu tufikamanu mu diana dioso ku kundu ki nlemvo wu Nzambi muingi katumona kiadi ayi tutambula nlemvo wunsadisanga mu thangu yifuana.

5.1: Bila kadika pfumu yi ziganga Nzambi wunsobolongo va khatitsika batu, wumbiekongo mu diambu di batu mu kuba sadisa mu mambu ma Nzambi, muingi katambikanga makaba ma batu ayi makaba mayoko mu diambu di masumu.
5.2: Niandi wulenda sudika bumboti batu bobo bakambulu diela ayi batu bobo banzimbala bila niandi veka widi wulebakana.
5.3: Bila mamvandi, mu diambu di lebakana kuandi, diawu kafueti tambikilanga makaba mu diambu di masumu mandi veka ayi mu diambu di masumu ma batu.
5.4: Mutu kalendi kukivana nzitusu wowo ko enati Nzambi kasia kuntela mbila ko banga bu bela Aloni.
5.5: Bobuawu Klisto mamvandi kasia kiniemisa ko mu bieko pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi. Vayi mutu wuna wunniemisa, niandi wutuba ti :
5.7: Mu bilumbu bi luzingu luandi lu kintoto, niandi wutambika zitsambulu ayi zindombolo mu yamikina ayi mu matsuela mu meso kuidi mutu wowo wulenda kumvukisa mu lufua. Mu diambu di kinzikanga Nzambi, niandi wubaka mvutu.
5.8: Ka diambu ko wuba Muana, vayi wulonguka tumama mu ziphasi ziozi kamona.
5.9: Bu kamana kitulu mutu wufuana, wuyika tho yi phulusu yi kayimani kuidi bobo beti kuntumukina.
5.10: Niandi wubieko kuidi Nzambi pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi banga buididi Meleshisedeki.
5.11: Mambu mawombo madi yeto matuba mu diambu di nsamu wawu vayi phasi madi mu sudikisa bila luyikidi miolo mu sudika.
5.12: Nganu thama luyika minlongi mu mambu ma Nzambi ; vayi nate buabu lukidi moni mfunu balulonga malongi ma thonono mu mambu ma Nzambi. Luyikidi banga batu bobo beti mona tsatu miliki vayi bika tsatu bidia bingolo.
5.13: Bila woso kuandi mutu wunsadilanga miliki kasi zaba ko Mambu ma busonga, bila wukidi muana lezi.
5.14: Vayi bidia bingolo bidi mu diambu di bakulutu ; bila bawu bayuku sadilanga diela diawu mu tulanga luviakunu mu mamboti ayi mu mambimbi.

6.1: Diawu tubikeno viokisa thangu mu malongi ma thonono ma Klisto, vayi bika tubaluka kuidi malongi ma bakulutu mu kambu buela tula zifundasio. Bu dinsundula ti : balula khadulu yintotukilanga mu mavanga mannatanga ku lufua ayi mu minu mu Nzambi,
6.2: mu malongi ma mbotokolo ayi ma thetokolo yi mioko, mu mfulukulu yi bafua ayi mu tsambusulu yi mvu ka mvu.
6.3: Buna buawu bobo tuela vanga enati Nzambi veni minsua.
6.4: Bila bulendi baka bubela ko ti batu bobo batuama kienzolo, bobo babimba lueki lu dikaba di Diyilu, bobo baba kithuadi mu Pheve Yinlongo,
6.5: bobo babimba lueki lu Mambu ma Nzambi ayi lulendo lu tsungi yidi ku ntuala,
6.6: vayi bawu bua, buna balendi buela vutuka balula mavanga ko bila balembo bandi muana Nzambi va dikulusi mu diambu diawu vekaayi balembo mfuisi tsoni va meso ma batu.
6.7: Bila ntoto wowo wunokonongo zimvula ziwombo ayi weti buta bikunusu binsadulungu kuidi batu bobo bakununu wawu, buna Nzambi wunsakumunanga ntoto beni.
6.8: Vayi enati ntoto beni weti buta zitsolokoto ayi zitsendi buna wusiedi kadi luvalu ko. Buna weka nduka singu bosi tsukuluꞌandi yoko ku mbazu.
6.9: A bakundi ba luzolo, ka diambu ko tuntuba bobo vayi diana tusidi ti lubeki mambu malutidi mu mboti, mannatanga ku phulusu.
6.10: Bila Nzambi widi wusonga ; kalendi zimbakana ko kisalu kioki lusala ayi luzolo lueno lolo lumonisa mu diambu di dizina diandi bu lusadila banlongo ayi lukidi ku basadila.
6.11: Tutidi ti kadika mutu mu beno kamonisa bufula bu phila yoyi mu diambu di keba diana di duka nate kuna tsukulu ;
6.12: mu diambu lubika kituka miolo vayi lusokudila batu bobo beti vingila kiuka kioki bavanina tsila, mu minu ayi mu mvibudulu.
6.13: Nzambi bu kavana tsila kuidi Abalahami, Nzambi wulevila ndefi mu dizina diandi veka, bu kasia baka ko mutu wunkaka wunlutila wowo kafueti levila ndefi ;
6.14: ayi wukamba ti : bukiedika, ndiela kusakumuna buwombo ayi ndiela todisa nkunꞌaku.
6.15: Mu mvibudulu yingolo Abalahami kavingidila ayi katambudila mambu momo mamvanina Nzambi tsila.
6.16: Bila batu beta levila ndefi mu dizina di mutu wunkaka wubalutidi. Bila, mu diambu diawu, ndefi yidi dimbu mu manisa ziphakazioso.
6.17: Diawu Nzambi bu kazola monisa kuidi batu bobo bela vinginina kiuka kiandi kioki kavanina tsila ti lukanu luandi lulendi baluka ko, buna wuleva ndefi.
6.18: Mu diambu di mambu muadi malendi viakana ko, mawu mammonisa ti Nzambi kalendi vuna ko. Mu mawu tubaka bu kindusulu mu simbidila diana diodi tukubukulu, beto tumana baka suamunu.
6.19: Diana diodi didi kuidi beto banga sengo kinsingiminanga muela, diana beni didi dikinda ayi dingolo. Diana beni dinkotanga, sabuka lido nate ku khati buangu kioki kilutidi nlongo,
6.20: kuna ku kota Yesu banga ntuami ntuala, mu diambu dieto. Wuyikidi pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi mu zithangu zioso banga buididi Meleshisedeki.

7.1: Bila Meleshisedeki beni, ntinu wu Salemi, Nganga Nzambi yi Nzambi yizangama, wuyenda dengana Abalahami bu kaba ku mvita yika kanuana ayi kabedisila mintinu miwombo. Buna Meleshisedeki beni wunsakumuna.
7.2: Ayi Abalahami wuvana kuku ki kumi mu bima bioso biobikabaka kuidi Meleshisedeki.
7.3: Meleshisedeki kasia ba kadi dise ayi kadi ngudi ko ayi kikhulu kiandi kisi zabakana ko. Thonono yi bilumbu biandi ayi tsukusunu yi luzingu luandi bisi zabakana ko vayi luzingu luandi ludedakani ayi lu Muana Nzambi ; widi Nganga Nzambi mu zithangu zioso.
7.4: Tala boso bu kabela mutu wunneni, mutu wowo Abalahami kavana kuku ki kumi ki bima bi kabaka bu tuzebi ti Abalahami niandi dise di makanda.
7.5: Ayi mu batu bobo badi mu bana ba Levi bansalanga kinganga babeki minsua mi tambulanga kuku ki kumi boso buididi Mina, kuidi batu bu dinsundula bakhomba, ka diambu ko batotukila mu luketo lu Abalahami.
7.6: Vayi Meleshisedeki, kasi mu dikanda di bana ba Levi ko vayi wutambula kuku ki kumi kuidi Abalahami ayi wusakumuna mutu wowo wutambula zitsila zi Nzambi.
7.7: Mu kambu findana ziphaka beto boso tuzebi ti mutu wowo sakumuni niandi lutidi ayi mutu wowo basakumuni.
7.8: Banganga Nzambi bantambulanga kuku ki kumi badi batu bamfuanga vayi Meleshisedeki wutambula kuku ki kumi kiaki, wulembo telomono kimbangi ti widi moyo.
7.9: Tulenda tuba ti Levi wuntambulanga kuku ki kumi mamvandi wuvana kuku ki kumi mu nzila yi Abalahami.
7.10: Bila buna kabutukidi ko, vayi buna wukidi mu luketo lu nkulu andi mu thangu Meleshisedeki kadengana Abalahami.
7.11: Enati diluaku didi mu ba wufuana mu nzila yi kinganga ki ba Levi, bila mu kiawu batu bavanunu Mina, buna mfunu mbi widi mu buela bieka diaka nganga Nzambi yinkaka mu ntanda wu Meleshisedeki vayi kasia bieko ko boso buididi Aloni e ?
7.12: Bila bawu viakisa kinganga buna Mina miviakini.
7.13: Bila mutu wowo wutubulu mambu beni widi muisi dikanda dinkaka, mu kambulu mutu wusala va diziku di
7.14: bila dizabikini ti Pfumu eto wutotukila mu dikanda di Yuda, dikanda dikambu tubila Moyize mu diambu di kinganga.
7.15: Tala diambu dilutidi zabakana bu tumueni ti : Nganga Nzambi yinkaka yitotukidi yidi mu ntanda wu Meleshisedeki ;
7.16: kasia bieko Nganga Nzambi ko mu lusadusu lu Mina boso buididi lutumunu lu batu vayi boso buididi lulendo lu luzingu lu kalulendi bungana ko.
7.18: Buna Mina mituama mibotolo mu diambu di misiala lulendo ko ayi misiala ko mfunu.
7.19: Bila Mina misia fuanisa kadi diambu dimosi ko. Vayi diana dimboti dikotoso ; mu diawu tulenda fikiminina Nzambi.
7.20: Mamo momo mavangimina mu ndefi yi leva Nzambi. Bila bana bayika zinganga zinzambi mu kambu leva ndefi.
7.21: Vayi Yesu wuyika nganga Nzambi boso bu bela ndefi yi leva Nzambi bu kankamba ti :
7.22: Buna Yesu wuyika mvangi wu zitsila mu nguizani yoyi yilutidi kitoko.
7.23: Banganga Nzambi baba ziwombo mu kisalu ki kinganga mu diambu lufua luba kuba bikilanga ko thangu mu sala kisalu kiawu mu zithangu zioso bila baba fuanga wumosi-wumosi.
7.24: Vayi Yesu widi moyo mu zithangu zioso ayi diawu kadidi ayi kinganga kioki kilendi yekodolo mutu ko.
7.25: Diawu kalenda vukisila batu boso bobo bamfikama Nzambi mu niandi sumbu kadi moyo mu zithangu zioso mu diambu di kuba lombila.
7.26: Bukiedika ti pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yi phila yoyi yifueni kuidi beto ; niandi widi wunlongo, kasi zaba kadi diambu dimosi ko, kadi disumu kasi ko ayi widi wumvambana ayi bankua masumu ; niandi wutombolo ku yilu viokila diyilu.
7.27: Bapfumu zi zinganga Nzambi bankaka zifueti tambikanga kadika lumbu makaba mu diambu di masumu mawu veka bosi mu diambu di masumu ma batu boso. Vayi kuidi niandi kasi mfunu mu vanganga buawu ko bila niandi wutumbu manisa mamo mu khumbu yimosi bu kakivana niandi veka.
7.28: Mina mibieka batu balebakana mu ba bapfumu banganga Nzambi. Vayi mambu ma ndefi matotuka ku manima ma Mina, mabieka muana widi wufuana mu zithangu zioso.

8.1: Diambu di mfunu mu mambu tuyolukidi diawu diadi : beto tubeki Pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yinneni banga yayi, yidi ku Diyilu, va koko ku lubakala lu Kundu ki nkembo ki niandi veka Pfumu Nzambi.
8.2: Pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi beni widi banga kisadi mu buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo, nzo ngoto yitungu kuidi niandi Pfumu vayi bika kuidi batu.
8.3: Yoso-yoso Pfumu yy zinganga Nzambi yeti bieko mu diambu ditambikanga makaba ayi makaba mayoko. Diawu bufueni ti Pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yayi, mamvandi kafueti ba ayi kima kioki kafueti tambikanga.
8.4: Enati wuba va ntoto, nganu kasia ba Nganga Nzambi ko, bila vadi ayi banganga Nzambi ziozi zintambikanga makaba boso buididi Mina.
8.5: Ziawu zieti sadila mfikula ayi kitsuisula ki bima bi diyilu banga Nzambi bu kalubudila Moyize bu kabaka lukanu lu tunga nzo ngoto ti : keba, ngeyo wela vangila bibioso boso buididi kifuani kioki bammonisa ku mbata mongo.
8.6: Vayi buabu Yesu wuyekodolo kisalu kilutidi mu kitoko bila niandi widi phovi yi nguizani yilutidi kitoko yitungu va zitsila zi kitoko.
8.7: Bukiedika, enati Nguizani yitheti yiba yikambu tsembolo nganu kadi mfunu mu viakisa yawu mu nguizani yimmuadi.
8.9: Bika sia ti boso buididi Nguizani yoyi
8.10: Pfumu tubidi ti : mu bilumbu bina, yawu yayi
8.11: Kuisi ko mutu wela mona mfunu mu longa ndiandi
8.12: Bila ndiela kuba mona kiadi mu zinzimbala ziawu.
8.13: Bu katuba ti : Nguizani yimona buna wukitula yoyi yitheti yikhulu. Muaki yoyi yinkitukanga yikhulu ayi yoyi yeti nuna buna yimbanga nduka mu zimbala.

9.1: Mu nguizani yitheti, muba ayi zithumunu mu diambu di lusambulu ayi buangu kinlongo ki kintoto.
9.2: Batunga nzo ngoto. Mu ndambu yitheti muawu muba kima kioki bankietikanga muinda ayi meza ayi mapha matambuku kuidi Nzambi. Ndambu beni yawu “Buangu kinlongo.”
9.3: Ku manima ma mbusa lido kuawu kuba nzo ngoto batedila “Buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo”.
9.4: Muna khati muawu muba kimfimbu ki nolo ayi kesi yi Nguizani yimana vindu nolo mu zindambu zioso. Muna kesi beni muawu muba mvungu wu nolo, mana ; nti wu Aloni wutotula biteka ayi zimeza zi matadi musonama mambu ma nguizani.
9.5: Vana mbata kesi vawu vaba zimbasi ziozi beti tedila : “Baselibe ba nkembo” ; zifuka mu kitsuisula ki mavavi mawu buanguki nlemvo. Vayi buabu tulendi baka bu yolukila mambu mama mu dimosi-dimosi ko.
9.6: Mambu mama bu mamana kubuku ; banganga Nzambi babakotanga kadika thangu ku ndambu yitheti yi buangu kinlongo mu diambu di sala kisalu kiawu.
9.7: Vayi pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi niandi kaka wuba kotanga muna khati ndambu yinzole. Khumbu yimosi kaba mu kotilanga mu kadika mvu. Kadika khumbu kankota ayi menga momo kafueti tambika mu diambu di niandi veka ayi mu diambu di zinzimbala zi batu.
9.8: Pheve Yinlongo weti kutumonisa bumboti ti nzila yoyi yinkotolongo ku buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo yikidi yikangama sumbu nzo ngoto yitheti yikidi.
9.9: Yawu yidi mfikula mu diambu di thangu yayi. Diodi dinsundula ti makaba ayi makaba mayoko momo baba tambikanga kuidi Nzambi malendi nunga ko mu fuanisa bumboti mayindu ma ntima ma mutu wowo wuntambikanga mawu.
9.10: Bila mambu momo matedi kaka ndiwulu ; ndiunu ayi zitsukudulu zi phila mu phila. Mambu beni madi zithumunu zi kinsuni zivanu nate thangu Nzambi kela fuanisa mambu moso.
9.11: Klisto bu kayiza banga Pfumu yi banganga Nzambi mu diambu di kutuvana bima biobi bimboti katubakila tona thama, buna wusabuka buangu kinlongo kilutidi tola ayi kilutidi fuana. Kiawu kisia tungulu mu mioko mi batu ko ; kiawu kisi ki ntoto wawu ko.
9.12: Khumbu yimosi kaka kakotila muna buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo ; wutambika, bika sia ti menga ma zikhombo voti ma zingombi vayi wutambika menga mandi veka. Buawu bobo katubakila khudulu yi kayimani.
9.13: Bila enati menga ma zikhombo ayi ma zingombi zimbakala votidibombi di ngombi yi kheto, diodi divindulu batu bobo basumuka, dieti kuba vedisanga va mbata nitu.
9.14: Vayi tufueti zaba ti menga ma Klisto, mutu wowo mu lusadusu lu Pheve yi mvu ka mvu, wukiyekula niandi veka kuidi Nzambi banga dikaba dikambulu ditona, mela vedisa mayindu meto ma ntima mu mavanga meti natanga ku lufua muingi tusadila Nzambi yi moyo.
9.15: Diawu diodi Klisto kadidi phovi yi Nguizani yimona muingi babo batelo batambula kiuka kika kisukanga ko, kioki kivanunu tsila. Bila Klisto niandi wufua mu diambu di kuba kula mu masumu momo bavola mu Nguizani yitheti.
9.16: Bila vadi tesitama9.16 Tesitama : widi nkanda wummonisa buevi bufueti sadulu bima bi mutu niandi bu kafuidi. buna vana vafueti telomono kimbangi ki lufua lu mutu wusonika kiawu.
9.17: Bila mfunu tesitama wumonikanga mu thangu mutu wowo sonikini kiawu kafuidi. Kisi kadi mfunu wumosi ko mu thangu mutu wusonika kiawu kakidi zingi.
9.18: Diawu Nguizani yitheti bu yitona, buna menga matengolo.
9.19: Bila Moyize bu kamana sudikisa zithumunu zioso zi Mina kuidi batu, wubonga menga ma bana ba zingombi ayi ma zikhombo zimbakala va kimosi ayi nlangu, lino yi mbuaki ayi ditafi di nti bantedilanga “Izopi”, wumuangina buku va kimosi ayi batu boso ;
9.20: bu katuba : mama mawu menga ma Nguizani yoyi Nzambi kawizani ayi beno.
9.21: Bosi wumuangina diaka buangu kinlongo menga va kimosi ayi bima bioso beti sadila mu lusambulu.
9.22: Muaki nduka-nduka bima bioso bimvedosongo mu menga landila boso buididi Mina. Ayi enati menga makadi tenguka buna masumu malendi lemvokolo ko.
9.23: Buna diba diambu di mfunu ti zimfikula zi bima biobi bidi mu diyilu zifueti vedoso mu bima bi phila yina. Vayi biawu veka bima bi diyilu bifueti vedosolo mu makaba mayoko malutidi kitoko.
9.24: Bila Klisto kasia kota ko mu buangu kinlongo kitungulu mu mioko mi batu, kidi kaka mfikula yi kioki kikiedika. Vayi niandi wukota ku khati diyilu mu diambu kamonika va meso ma Nzambi mu diambu dieto.
9.25: Bika sia ti wukota muawu mu diambu kakitambika niandi veka mu zikhumbu ziwombo banga bueti vangilanga pfumu yi banganga Nzambi, mutu wunkotanga kadika mvu ku buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo va kimosi ayi menga mangana.
9.26: Bila enati bobo nganu zikhumbu ziwombo kamonina ziphasi tona ntoto wuvangulu. Vayi buabu wumonika mu khumbu yimosi mu tsukulu yi thangu mu diambu di katula masumu bu kakitambika niandi veka banga dikaba.
9.27: Sambusu buidi ti mutu khumbu yimosi kaka keti fua, bosi weka
9.28: bobuawu, Klisto wukitambika khumbu yimosi mu diambu di nata masumu ma batu bawombo. Bosi wela monika mu khumbu yimmuadi, bika sia ti muingi kanata masumu ma batu, vayi mu diambu di nata phulusu kuidi batu bobo balembo mvingila.

10.1: Mina midi kitsuisula ki mambu mamboti momo mankuiza vayi bika khatika lunitu lu mambu beni. Buna Mina milendi ko fuanisa, mu diambu di makaba momo bantambikanga thangu ka thangu kadika mvu, batu bobo bamfikamanga Nzambi.
10.2: Enati minunga, nganu batu bobo bantambikanga makaba momo balendi buela tambikanga mawu ko bila nganu bu bakivedosolo mu khumbu yimosi balendi buela bela ko masumu mawu mayindu.
10.3: Vayi mu makaba momo baba tambikanga muawu baba tebukilanga, kadika mvu, masumu mawu moyo.
10.4: Bila menga ma zingombi ayi ma zikhombo malendi botula ko masumu.
10.5: Diawu Klisto katubila bu kayiza va nza ti :
10.8: Wutuama tuba ti : Ngeyo wumanga kuaku makaba, makaba mayoko, makaba ma bibulu biobi bayokila, makaba mayoko mu diambu di masumu. Kadi khini wusia mamona ko. Muaki makaba beni maba tambukungu boso bubela Mina.
10.9: Bosi wutuba diaka : Minu ndizidi mu diambu di vanga luzolo luaku. Buawu bobo kabotudila makaba moso ma khulu ayi kavingisila va buangu beni dikaba di Klisto.
10.10: Mu luzolo lolo tukitudulu banlongo mu diambu di dikaba ditambika Yesu Klisto bu katambika nitu andi veka mu khumbu yimosi.
10.11: Kadika nganga Nzambi kafueti telamanga kadika lumbu mu sala kisalu kiandi ayi mu tambikanga kadika thangu makaba mo mawu, momo malendi botula masumu.
10.12: Vayi Klisto niandi bu katumbu tambika dikaba dimosi kaka mu diambu di masumu buna wuvuanda va koko ku lubakala lu Nzambi.
10.13: Kuna kamvingidila Nzambi kakitula bambeni bandi banga kima kinketo kongo bitambi biandi.
10.14: Bila mu diambu di dikaba dimosi kaka niandi wukitula, mu zithangu zioso batu bafuana ; bobo kavedisa mu masumu.
10.15: Pheve Yinlongo, wututelimina kimbangi mu diambu beni bila wutuama tuba ti :
10.16: Pfumu kakembi : bilumbu bina bu biela vioka,
10.18: Muaki masumu mawu lemvokolo, kadi mfunu kusiedi ko mu buela tambikanga makaba mu diambu di masumu.
10.19: Diawu bakhomba, sumbu tuidi ayi diana di kotila ku buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo mu diambu di menga ma Yesu,
10.20: mu nzila yimona ayi yi moyo yoyi katuzibudila mu lido ; yi buangu kilutidi nlongo ayi nlongo lido beni nitu andi.
10.21: Ayi sumbu tubeki Pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi yinyadila Nzo Nzambi,
10.22: diawu bika tufikama vadi Nzambi mu mintima milulama, mudiana dioso diodi dintotukilanga minu va kimosi ayi mintima mivedoso mu mayindu mambimbi ma ntima ayi nitu yisukulu mu nlangu wuvedila.
10.23: Diawu bika tusimbidila bumboti diana diodi tuzebi ti didi di kiedika bila mutu wowo wutuvana zitsila widi wukuikama.
10.24: Tusungasananga beto na beto mu diambu di salasananga beto na beto muingi tumonikisa luzolo ayi vanga mavanga mamboti.
10.25: Tubikeno tina mabundu meto banga bueti vangila batu bankaka ; vayi bika tukikindisanga beto na beto bu lumueni ti lumbu ki Pfumu kieka nduka.
10.26: Enati tulembo vodi masumu mu luzolo bu tumana tambula nzayilu yi kiedika, buna kusiedi diaka dikaba ko mu diambu di masumu.
10.27: Vayi tufueti kaka vingila, mu tsisi, tsambusu ayi mbazu yingolo yela zinisa zimbzni zioso zi Nzambi.
10.28: Woso mutu wummanga tumukina Mina mi Moyize kafueti fua mu kambu kiadi mu kimbangi ki batu buadi voti batu batatu.
10.29: Yindulanu beno veka, buevi buela bela thumbudulu yingolo yoyi yela tambula mutu wowo wela lenza Muana Nzambi, wela mona menga ma nguizani, mu momo kavedosolo ti masi kadi mfunu ko ayi wumfinga Pheve Yinlongoyi nlemvo e ?
10.30: Bila tuzebi bumboti mutu wowo wutuba :
10.31: Didi diambu di tsisi mu bua mu mioko mi Nzambi yi moyo.
10.32: Lutebukila moyo bilumbu bituama biobi lutambudila kiezila ki Nzambi, beno luvibidila ziphasi zi khindu yinneni.
10.33: Bila zithangu zinkaka balu finga va meso ma batu bawombo ayi balu monisa ziphasi ; zithangu zinkaka lufubakana ayi batu bankaka bammona ziphasi banga ziozi lulembo moni.
10.34: Bila lufubakana mu ziphasi zi batu baba mu nloko ayi beno veka lummona khini bu baluziona bima bieno bu luzebi ti kimvuama bu kitoko ayi kinzingilanga buidi yeno.
10.35: Kadi loza diana dieno bila dibeki mfutu wunneni.
10.36: Bila mfunu wu thatumunu widi yeno muingi lutambula mambu momo Nzambi kaluvanina tsila bu lumeni vanga luzolo luandi.
10.37: Bila fioti fisiedi, fioti kuandi fisiedi
10.38: Muaki mutu widi wusonga va meso mama wela zingila mu minu
10.39: Beto tuisi ko mu ntanda wu batu bobo bamvutukanga ku mbusa muingi tuzimbala vayi tuidi mu ntanda wu batu bobo badi minu ayi baambula phulusu.

11.1: Minu kinsundula tula diana dingolo mu bima, biobi bi nsiwulungu diana ayi ayi kikinina ti wutambudi bima ka diambu ko bimonikini ko.
11.2: Mu diambu di minu bakulu batelomono kimbangi.
11.3: Mu diambu di minu tuzabidi ti nza yivangulu mu mbembo yi Nzambi, ayi, bima bioso biobi bieti monika bivangimina mu biobi kabi monikanga ko.
11.4: Mu diambu di minu, Abeli wutambika kuidi Nzambi dikaba diyoko dilutidi dimboti viokila ditambika Kayini. Mu diambu di minu Nzambi kammonina mutu wusonga bu katelama niandi veka kimbangi ti wukikinina makaba mandi. Ayi mu diambu di minu Abeli wukidi yoluka diaka, ka diambu ko wufua kuandi.
11.5: Mu diambu di minu, Enoki wukatulu mu diambu kabika mona lufua. Basia kummona ko bila Nzambi wunkatula. Muaki tuamina kakatulu, bantelimina kimbangi kiaki : Niandi wumonisa Nzambi khini.
11.6: Muaki mutu kambulu minu kalendi monisa Nzambi khini ko. Bila bulutidi mboti ti woso mutu tidi fikama Nzambi kawilukila ti Nzambi widi ayi kafueti wilukila ti niandi wumfutanga batu boso bankuntombanga.
11.7: Mu diambu di minu, mu thangu Nzambi kalubula Nowa mu mambu momo katueni mona, wukinzika Nzambi ayi wutunga masuwa mu diambu di vukisa nzoꞌandi. Mu minu kiandi, wuzengila nza nkanu ayi wukituka mvingidi wu kiuka ki busonga kintotukilanga mu minu.
11.8: Mu diambu di minu, Abalahami wutumamana, bu katelo, mu kuenda ku tsi yoyi kafueti tambula banga kiuka ; ka diambu ko kasia zaba ko kuevi kankuenda.
11.9: Mu diambu di minu niandi wuzingila mu kinzenza mu tsi yi tsila ; wuzingila mu zinzo zingoto va kimosi ayi Isaki ayi Yakobi ; bobo baba mu tsila yimosi banga niandi.
11.10: Bila niandi wuvingila divula didi zifundasio ziozi zilendi nikuka ko. Nzambi niandi nkubiki ayi ntungi wu divula beni.
11.11: Mu diambu di minu ; Sala mamvandi, wubaka zingolo zi butila ka diambu ko mimvu mi butila mivioka ; bila wumona ti mutu wowo wuvana tsila widi wukuikama.
11.12: Diawu mu mutu wumosi, mutu wowo wuyika nunu, wuba nduka mu fua, mu butukila nkuna wu batu bobo baviokidi zimbuetete zi Diyilu ayi baviokidi tsengisini yidi va disimu di mbu, yilendi baka bu tangulu ko.
11.13: Batu bobo bafuila mu minu mu kambu baka bima biobi baba vanina tsila, vayi bamona biawu ayi bavana biawu mboti buna bakidi thama ayi bawu veka bazaba ti badi banzenza ayi minkibi vava ntoto.
11.14: Batu bantubila bobo bammonisa bumboti ti tsi awu veka bantomba.
11.15: Bila enati beti yindula tsi yoyi batotukila nganu babaka diluaku di buela mu vutuka.
11.16: Vayi buabu tsi yi kitoko bantomba, tsi yi diyilu. Diawu Nzambi kamonanga tsoni ko ti bantedila Nzambi awu, bila wuba kubikila divula.
11.17: Mu diambu di minu, Abalahami wutambika Isaki banga dikaba diyoko mu thangu Nzambi kantota. Niandi wutambula tsila vayi wuba wukubama mu tambika muanꞌandi wumosi kaka.
11.18: Ka diambu ko Nzambi wunkamba : Mu Isaki wela bakila nkuna.
11.19: Abalahami wumona ti Nzambi beki lulendo lu fulukisila Isaki mu bafua. Bukiedika Abalahami wutambula Isaki bu bamfulukisa.
11.20: Mu diambu di minu, Isaki wusakumuna Yakobi ayi Esawu mu diambu di mambu momo mankuiza ku ntuala.
11.21: Mu diambu di minu, Yakobi, tuamina lufua luandi, wusakumuna kadika muana wu Zozefi ayi wusambila Nzambi bu kasingimina mutsongi ntiꞌandi.
11.22: Mu diambu di minu, Zozefi, bu kamona ti weka nduka fua, wuyolukila thotokolo yi bana ba Iseli mu tsi Ezipite ayi wuvana lutumunu mu diambu di mambu momo bafueti vanga mu mimvesi miandi.
11.23: Mu diambu di minu, bambuta ba Moyize basueka muanꞌawu mu tezo ki zingondi zitatu bila zimona ti muana wuba wukitoko ayi kadi tsisi zisia mona ko mu tinguna lutumunu lu ntinu.
11.24: Mu diambu di minu, Moyize, bu kayunduka, wumanga kuandi tedolo muana wu muana wunketo wu Falawo.
11.25: Wumanga mona makhini mu ndambu thangu madi mu masumu vayi wuluta zola mona ziphasi va kimosi ayi batu ba Nzambi.
11.26: Bila niandi wumona tsoni yoyi Klisto kafueti fua yidi kimvuama kinneni kiviokidi kioki ki Ezipite bila meso mandi maba ntadidila mfutu wowo widi ku ntuala.
11.27: Mu diambu di minu, niandi wubika Ezipite mu kambu mona zinganzi zi ntinu tsisi. Wuba wukinda, bila niandi wumona Nzambi yika yimonikanga ko.
11.28: Mu diambu di minu, niandi wukembila pasika ayi wudukula menga mu mielo mu diambu di mbasi yitumu mu bunga yibika bunga bana batheti ba bana ba Iseli.
11.29: Mu diambu di minu, bana ba Iseli basabuka mbu wu mbuaki banga mu ntoto wuyuma. Vayi basi Ezipite bu bedi ka sabuka buna bamana diama.
11.30: Mu diambu di minu, bibaka bi Yeliko bi bua bana ba Iseli bu bazunga biawu tsambudi di bilumbu.
11.31: Mu diambu di minu, Lahabi, ka diambu ko wuba kuandi ndumba leta, wuvuka mu lufua va kimosi ayi batu bobo bamanga tumukina Nzambi, mu diambu kayakula bumboti batu batumu mu kinsueki mu tala Yeliko mu diela.
11.32: A mambu mbi ndieka buela tuba e ? Buna thangu mayiba yi fioti enati mfueti yolukila Ngedewoni, Balaki, Samisoni, Zefeti, Davidi, Samueli ayi mimbikudi.
11.33: Mu diambu di minu bawu babedisa mintinu, bavanga mambu ma busonga, batambula mambu momo baba vanina tsila ; bakangisa miunu mi zikhosi ;
11.34: bazima lulendo lu zimbazu zingolo ; bavuka bu bedi kavondo mu sabala ; batambula zingolo ka diambu ko baba bavonga ; bamonika binuani bingolo ku mvita ; batinisa nkangu wu masodi ma banzenza.
11.35: Mu diambu di minu kiawu baketo baba vutudila batu bawu bafua, mu mfulukulu.
11.36: Bankaka basekonono, babeto bikoti, babakanga zisieni ayi bakotoso mu minloko.
11.37: Bankaka balozolo matadi, babasu mu bisi banga bu mbasulungu mabaya ; bavondolo mu bisabala, bakituka mindiengidi, bamvuata minkanda mi mamemi ayi mi zikhombo. Bakambu mamo ayi bibioso, babamonisa ziphasi ayi bayamusu.
11.38: Nza yisia ba yifuana mu diambu diawu ko. Badiengila mu makanga ayi mu miongo ; mu zithadi ayi mu mabulu madi mu ntoto.
11.39: Batu boso bobo, ka diambu ko batelomono kimbangi mu diambu di minu kiawu, vayi, kadi mutu kasia tambula ko bina biba vanunu tsila.
11.40: Bila Nzambi wutukubikila mambu ma kitoko, wuzola ti bakituka batu bafuana banga beto.

12.1: Sumbu tuzungulu kuidi bambangi bawombo, bika tulozanu bizitu bioso ayi masumu makutuzungidilanga mu zindambu zioso. Vayi bika tuzawula thinu mu kambu vonga mu tsisani yidi yeto ku ntuala.
12.2: Bika thalu eto yiba kaka kuidi Yesu bila niandi wutona ayi wudukisa minu kieto. Niandi, mu diambu di khini yoyi yiba ku ntualꞌandi, wuvibidila va dikulusi ; kasia mona tsoni ko ayi buabu vuendi va koko ku lubakala lu kundu ki Kipfumu ki Nzambi.
12.3: Bika luyindulanu mutu wowo wuvibidila batu ba masumu, muingi lubika vonga ayi lebakana mu miela mieno.
12.4: Bu lueti nuanisa masumu, lutudidi ko mu tezo ki totula menga.
12.5: Buna luzimbakana kueno mambu mama makulukindisanga, momo Nzambi kalukamba banga ti niandi wunyoluka kuidi bana bandi e ?
12.6: bila Pfumu wuntumbudilanga mutu wowo keta zola,
12.7: Luvibidila ziphasi zieno. Nzambi ziawu zidi mu diambu di kululudika. Nzambi wukulumonanga banga bana. Muana mbi wowo kakabakanga thumbudulu ko kuidi Dise ?
12.8: Enati lukadi baka thumbudulu yoyi yintambulanga bana boso, buna diodi dimmonisa ti luidi bana ba kindumba ; luisi khatika bana ko.
12.9: Beto tuba ayi madise meto ma kinsuni makutuvananga thumbudulu vayi tukubakinzikanga. Mbi bi kutukandika mu luta tumukina dise di diyilu muingi tuzinga e ?
12.10: Madise meto ma kinsuni makutuvananga thumbudulu mu ndambu thangu, boso bubela mayindu mawu vayi Nzambi wukutuvananga thumbudulu mu diambu di mamboti meto, muingi mamveto tuba kithuadi mu bunlongo buandi.
12.11: Bukiedika ti mu thangu yayi, thumbudulu yidi diambu di kiadi, bika di khini. Vayi kunzimunina yimbutanga luzingu lusonga lunzingulungu mu ndembama kuidi bawu batambula thumbudulu beni.
12.12: Diawu vumunanu mioko mieno mivonga ayi makuma meno ma lebakana,
12.13: bika luludika minsolo mu diambu di malu meno ; mu diambu di kulu ku bela kubika luta fumbuka vayi ku beluka.
12.14: Tunuananu mu ba mu ndembama ayi batu boso ayi zinga luzingu lunlongo bila kambu luzingu lunlongo, mutu kalendi mona Pfumu ko.
12.15: Lulubuka tala mutu kabika kambu nlemvo wu Nzambi, mu diambu di muanzi wu ndudi wedi mena va luidi ; muingi wubika totula divunzi ayi wubika bivisa bawombo mu beno.
12.16: Lulubuka muingi muna luidi, mutu kabika sala kindumba voti sekinina mambu ma nlongo banga bubela Esawu ; mutu wusumbisa kikulutu kiandi mu diambu di bidia.
12.17: Bila, luzebi kueno ti kunzimunina bu kedi ka buela tomba baka kiuka ki lusakumunu, kasia kikununu ko bila diluaku disia buela ba ko muingi kaviakisa mambu mavanga dise diandi ; ka diambu ko boso kaba ntomba lusakumunu buna wulembo didi.
12.18: Lusia fikama ko banga bana ba Iseli, ku mongo wulenda simbu ; wowo wuba lema mbazu, ku tombi ki nkobo ayi ku vuka ;
12.19: voti ku tulumbeta ko voti ku mbembo yimosi yi tsisi yiba wakikisa mambu ma tsisi. Diawu batu bobo bawa yawu balomba mu diambu babika buela wa diaka mbembo beni.
12.20: Bila bamona ti balendi nunga ko mu kinzikanga lutumunu lolo lutotukila muawu ti : ka diambu ko bulu kinsimba mongo, kifueti vondolo mu matadi.
12.21: Mambu beni bu mabela ngolo tsisi, diawu niandi veka Moyize kayamikina ti : Tsisi ndimmona ayi ndieka tita.
12.22: Vayi beno lutumbu fikama ku mongo wu Sioni, ku divula di Nzambi yi moyo, ku Yelusalemi di Diyilu ayi kuidi minkangu na minkangu mi zimbasi midi mu nkembo ;
12.23: ayi kuidi Dibundu di bana batheti ba Nzambi bobo mazina mawu madi masonama mu Diyilu. Beno lufikama kuidi Nzambi, zuzi di batu boso ; ayi kuidi ziphevi zi batu banlongo bamana fuana.
12.24: Beno lutumbu fikama kuidi Yesu, phovi yi Nguizani yimona ayi kuidi menga mandi matenguka ; momo meti yoluka bumboti viokila buyolukila menga ma Abeli.
12.25: Lukeba tala luedi kambu wila mutu wowo wulembo yoluka. Bila enati bobo bamanga wila mutu wowo wuba lubula vava ntoto, basia vuka ko mu thumbudulu ; buna buevi buela bela kuidi beto enati tutembi manima kuidi mutu wowo wulembo yoluka tona ku Diyilu e ?
12.26: Mbemboꞌandi yinikuna ntoto vayi buabu wuveni tsila yayi : Ndiela buela nikuna diaka, vayi bika sia ti wo ntoto kaka vayi ayi diyilu.
12.27: Diambu diadi : diaka dinsundula ti bima bioso bilenda nikunu biobi bivangama, biela viakusu mu diambu biobi bi kabinikukanga ko bizingila.
12.28: Diawu, sumbu tuela tambula kipfumu kioki kakilendi nikuka ko, bika tuzaba vutudilanga Nzambi matondo ayi tunsadila mu phila yikumonisa khini mu tumamana ayi mu lukinzu.
12.29: Bila Nzambi eto widi mbazu yeti zinisanga.

13.2: Lubika zimbakananga yakulanga banzenza bumboti bila batu bankaka bayakula zimbasi mu kambu zaba.
13.3: Lutebukilanga moyo batu badi mu nloko banga ti mamveno luidi bakangama va kimosi ayi bawu. Lutebukilanga moyo batu bobo banyamusu bila beno mamveno lubeki zinitu ziozi zilenda yamusu.
13.4: Bika batu boso bakinzikanga dikuela. Mfulu yi batu bakuela yifueti banga yivedila bila Nzambi wela sambisa batu boso bansadilanga kindumba ayi kitsuza.
13.5: Bika khadulu eno yibika diatusu kuidi luzolo lu zimbongo. Monanganu khini mu bima bibi bidi yeno bila niandi veka Nzambi wutuba ti : Ndilendi kuyekula ko, ndilendi ku loza ko !
13.6: Diawu tubeki bu tubila mu diana dioso, ti :
13.7: Lutebukilanga moyo mintuadisi mieno mi lulonga mambu ma Nzambi. Luyindulanga tsukulu yi khadulu awu ayi lusokudila minu kiawu.
13.8: Yesu Klisto widi phila yimosi kibedi yono ayi lumbu kiaki ayi mu mimvu mikamimani.
13.9: Lubika vunu mu malongi ma phila mu phila ayi ma nzenza. Bila bulutidi mfunu mintima mikindusu mu nlemvo wu Nzambi vayi bika mu khebolo yi mina mitedi ndiwulu, bila misadisanga ko bobobansadilanga miawu.
13.10: Tubeki diziku dintambukulungu makaba vayi batu bobo bansalanga mu nzo ngoto basi ko minsua mu dia.
13.11: Bila Pfumu yi zinganga Nzambi wunata menga ma bibulu mu diambu di ndemvokolo yi masumu, ku Buangu kilutidi nlongo. Vayi zinitu zi bibulu beni ziyokolo ku difula di Ka.
13.12: Diawu Yesu mamvandi kamonina ziphasi ku difula di Ka, mu diambu di vedisa batu mu menga mandi.
13.13: Diawu bika tuenda kuidi niandi, kuna difula di Ka ayi tukikinina fua zitsoni ziozi kafua.
13.14: Bila vava tuisi ko divula dinzingilanga mu zithangu ziosovayi tulembo tombi divula diodi di nkuiza.
13.15: Mu diambu di Yesu, bika tutambikanga kuidi Nzambi dikaba di minkunga ; bu dinsundula ti tufueti sanisinanga dizina diandi.
13.16: Lubika zimbakana vanganga mamboti ayi kabulanga kuidi bakhomba bila makaba ma phila yoyi mawu mamonisanga Nzambi khini.
13.17: Lutumukinanga mintuadisi mieno ayi luba kinzikanga ; bila bawu beti sunga miela mieno ayi bela vumbudila Nzambi kipholo mu kisalu kiawu mu diambu basala kisalu kiawu mu khini vayi bika ku tsi manuinguta bila lulendi baka kadi lusadusu ko.
13.18: Lutusambidilanga bila tuzebi ti mayindu ma mintima mieto madi mamboti bu tutidi ba khadulu yimboti mu mambu moso.
13.19: Ndinluta kululomba luvanga diawu muingi ndivutulu nsualu kuidi beno.
13.20: Bika Nzambi yi ndembama, yoyi yifulukisa Pfumu eto Yesu mu bafua ; mutu wowo widi nsungi wunneni wu mamemi mu nzila yi menga ma Nguizani yikayimani,
13.21: kalukitula bafuana mu vanga mavanga mamo mamboti mu diambu di vanga luzolo luandi bu keti vanga mu beto mambu moso momo makummonisanga khini mu lulendo lu Yesu Klisto. Bika katambula nkembo mu mimvu mioso. Amen.
13.22: A bakhomba, ndikululubula mu vibidila mambu momo ndilulubudidi bila mu mambu ma khufi kaka ndilusonikini.
13.23: Muaki luzaba ti khombꞌeto Timote wutotolo mu nloko. Enati wela vika kuiza, buna ndiela kuiza kulutala va kimosi ayi niandi.
13.24: Luvana mboti kuidi mintuadisi mieno mioso ayi kuidi banlongo boso. Basi Itali baluveni mboti.
13.25: Bika nlemvo wuba yeno beno boso. Amen !

1.1: Polo, mvuala wu Yesu Klisto mu luzolo lu Nzambi, fidisidi nkanda kuidi banlongo badi ku Efeso ayi kuidi bobo badi bakuikama mu Yesu Klisto.
1.2: Bika Nzambi Dise dieto ayi Pfumu eto Yesu Klisto baluvana nlemvo ayi ndembama.
1.3: Bika Nzambi kakemboso,
1.4: Tuamina tula zifundasio zi ntoto,
1.5: Bu didi ti niandi wutuzola,
1.6: Mu diambu tusanisina
1.7: Mu niandi, beto tukudulu mu menga mandi ;
1.8: Wowo Nzambi kadukula mu
1.9: Niandi wutuzabikisa matsueki ma luzolo luandi
1.10: Mu diambu di dedikisa luawu
1.11: Mu diambu diandi beto tutambudi kuku kieto ki phulusu
1.12: Mu diambu tusanisina nkembo andi,
1.13: Mu niandi beno mamveno,
1.14: Pheve yinlongo yidi dimbu mu kutumonisa
1.15: Diawu tona mamvama bu ndiwilu buididi minu kieno mu Pfumu Yesu ayi luzolo luidi yeno mu banlongo boso ;
1.16: ndivonganga ko mu kuluvutudilanga matondo kuidi Nzambi. Ndieti kulutebukilanga moyo mu zitsambulu ziama ;
1.17: mu diambu Nzambi yi Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto, dise di nkembo kaluvana pheve yi nzayulu ayi yi tsongolo muingi lunzaba bumboti,
1.18: muingi kakienzula diela dieno ayi lusudika boso buididi diana diodi Nzambi kalutedila ayi boso buididi kimvuama ki nkembo wu kiuka kiandi va khatitsika banlongo ;
1.19: ayi boso buididi bunneni bu lulendo lolo luidi mu beto tuwilukila ; boso buididi lulendo lu zingolo ziandi.
1.20: Wumonisa lulendo beni bu kafulukisa Klisto mu bafua ayi bu kamvuandisa va koko kuandi ku lubakala, mu Diyilu ;
1.21: va yilu luyalu loso, kikulutu kioso, lulendo loso, kipfumu kioso ayi va yilu dizina dioso dizabikini ; bika sia ti mu tsungi yayi kaka vayi nate mu tsungi yela kuiza.
1.22: Wutula bima bioso ku tsi bitambi biandi ayi wumbieka Pfumuyi bima bioso mu Dibundu.
1.23: Dibundu diawu nitu andi, fuluka ku mutu wowo wumfulusanga bima bioso mu bibuangu bioso.

2.1: Mu thama beno bu luba bafua mu zinzimbala zieno ayi mu masumu meno ;
2.2: mu mawu beno ludiatila boso buididi ntoto wawu ayi boso buididi Pfumu yi lulendo lu mbimbi, pheve yinsalanga mu batu badi matingu.
2.3: Beto mamveto, tuba banga bawu ; tuzingila boso bubela zinzinunu zieto zi kinsuni ayi tudukisa luzolo lu nsuni ayi lu mayindu meto. Mu kimutu beto tuba batu bobo zinganzi zi Nzambi zifueti buila banga batu bankaka.
2.4: Vayi Nzambi nkua kimvuama mu kiadi mu diambu di luzolo lunneni lolokatuzodila ;
2.5: wutuzingisa va kimosi ayi Klisto ; beto bobo tuba bafua mu diambu di zinzimbala zieto. Mu nlemvo luvukila.
2.6: Wutufulukisa va kimosi ayi niandi ayi wutuvuandisa va kimosi, mu Diyilu, mu Klisto Yesu
2.7: mu diambu katumonisa mu zitsungi ziela kuiza bunneni bu kimvuama ki nlemvo andi mu diambu di mamboti mandi kuidi beto mu Klisto Yesu.
2.8: Bila mu nlemvo luvukila ; mu nzila yi minu. Luvulusu beni lusia ba kuidi beno ko vayi didi dikaba di Nzambi.
2.9: Bika sia ti mu mavanga luvukila muingi mutu kabika kuandi kukiniemisa.
2.10: Bila beto tuidi bivangu biandi ; tuvangu mu Klisto Yesu mu diambu di vanganga mavanga mamboti momo Nzambi kakubika tona thama muingi tusadila mawu.
2.11: Diawu, lutebuka moyo ti beno luba Bapakanu mu nsuni, baba kulutedilanga batu bakambu zengo kuidi bobo baba tedilanga bazengo. Nzengolo beni yivangimina, mu nitu, mu mioko mi batu.
2.12: Lutebuka moyo ti mu thangu beni, beno luba bavambana ayi Klisto, lusia ba minsua mu vuanda mu divula di Iseli ko bila luba banzenza mu zinguizani ziozi zivanunu tsila ; luba batu basobolo kuidi Nzambi ko bila luba banzenza mu zinguizani zi Nzambi zivanunu tsila ; luba batu bakambulu diana ayi bakambulu Nzambi va ntoto.
2.13: Vayi buabu, mu Klisto Yesu ; beno lutuama ba thama ayi Nzambi vayi luyikidi bafikama mu diambu di menga matengula Klisto.
2.14: Bila niandi ndembama yeto. Niandi wukitula Bayuda ayi Bapakanumutu wumosi ayi niandi wutiolumuna baka ki kithatu kioki kiba vambisa.
2.15: Bila mu nsuni andi niandi wuvonda mina va kimosi ayi zithumunu ziandiayi minsiku miandi. Diodi divangimina mu diambu di vanga mu niandi veka mutu wumosi wumona wuntotukila mu batu buadi. Buawu bobo kakotisila ndembama.
2.16: Mu diambu kabaka bu vutudila, mu nzila yi dikulusi, nguizani yi bawu buadi mu nitu yimosi kuidi Nzambi bu kavondila kimbeni kiawu va dikulusi.
2.17: Klisto wuyiza ayi wusamuna ndembama kuidi beno luba thama ayi wusamuna ndembama kuidi bobo baba bafikama.
2.18: Bila, mu diambu diandi, beto yawu tubeki minsua mu kota kuidi Tata mu Pheve yimosi.
2.19: Diawu, beno lusiedi diaka banzenza ko voti minkibi ko, vayi lueka buabu basi tsi va kimosi ayi banlongo ayi basi nzo yi Nzambi.
2.20: Beno lutungu va yilu fundasio yi bamvuala ayi mimbikudi. Yesu Klisto, niandi ditadi di mfunu di fuma.
2.21: Mu niandi nzo yoso yibundusulu va kimosi ayi yilembo yundukamu diambu yiba Nzo yi Nzambi yinlongo mu Pfumu.
2.22: Ayi mu niandi, beno lulembo tungulu va kimosi mu diambu lukituka nzo yimvuandanga Nzambi mu Pheve.

3.1: Mu diambu dieno beno Bapakanu, diawu minu Polo ndididi wukangama mu nloko wu Klisto.
3.2: Bila ndimbanza luwa phila yididi kisalu ki nlemvo kioki Nzambi kaphana mu diambu dieno.
3.3: Mu tsongolo, niandi wunzabikisa matsueki ma lukanu luandi. Mawumomo ndilusudikisidi mu zindambu zi mambu manneni.
3.4: Beno tanga wawu buna ma lusudika bumboti boso buididi diela diamamu diambu di matsueki momo ma Klisto.
3.5: Muaki mu zitsungi zikhulu Nzambi kasia tuama zabikisa matsueki beni kuidi batu ko banga phila kazabikisidi mawu buabu mu lusadusu lu pheve Yinlongo kuidi bamvuala bandi ayi kuidi mimbikudi miandi.
3.6: Dinsueki beni diawu diadi : mu diambu di Nsamu Wumbote, Bapakanu mu kithuadi kiawu ayi Yesu Klisto, babeki minsua va kimosi ayi Bayuda mu tambula kiuka kimosi kioki Nzambi kalembo lundila batu bandi. Beka binama binitu yimosi ayi bafubikini mu tsila yoyo Nzambi kavana mu Klisto Yesu.
3.7: Minu ndiyika kisadi ki Nsamu beni Wumboti boso buididi dikaba di nlemvo wu Nzambi ; nlemvo wowo kaphana mu lulendo luandi.
3.8: Nyinga, minu ndidi mutu wulutidi kambu minsua mu banlongo bosovayi Nzambi wuphana nlemvo wowo, wu samunina kuidi Bapakanu kimvuama ki Klisto bu kabulendi tezakana ko.
3.9: Ayi mu diambu di sudikisa bumboti va meso ma batu boso, buevi Nzambi, mutu wuvanga bima bioso, kalembo dukisila matsueki momo masueko thama ;
3.10: muingi buabu, mu nzila yi Dibundu, minyadi ayi bakulutu boso badi mu diyilu bazaba buididi diela di Nzambi mu ziphila zioso ;
3.11: banga bu kakubikila mawu tona thama momo malembo dedakana mu Klisto Yesu, Pfumu eto.
3.12: Mu diambu diandi ayi mu diambu di minu mu niandi buabu tubeki minsua mu telama va zizi ki Nzambi mu diana dioso.
3.13: Diawu ndikululomba, lubika vonga mu diambu di ziphasi ziama ziozindilembo moni mu diambu dieno ; bila ziawu zidi nkemboꞌeno.
3.14: Diawu ndieta fukimina, va ntuala Tata ;
3.15: bila mu niandi makanda moso ma batu bawilukila madi va ntoto ayi ku diyilu batambudila dizina.
3.16: Ndinkulombanga, boso buididi kimvuama ki nkemboꞌandi, mu diambu kalukindisa mu lulendo mu nzila yi Pheve andi mu matedi mutu wu khati.
3.17: Ayi mu diambu di Klisto kavuanda mu mintima mieno mu minu. Ndinlombanga diaka ti beno lumena mianzi ayi lutungu bumboti mu luzolo.
3.18: Buna buawu bobo lulenda baka bu sudikila va kimosi ayi banlongo boso phila luzolo lu Klisto luididi siadila, kula, phinda ayi zangama,
3.19: ayi zabila luzolo beni ti luawu luviatukidi nzayulu yoso ayi muingi luba bafuluka mu kinzambi kioso ki Nzambi.
3.20: Bika mutu wowo wulenda vanga mu buwombo-wombo viokila momo tueti lombanga voti tueti yindulanga boso buididi lulendo luandi lolo lueti sala mu beto,
3.21: katambula nkembo mu Dibundu ayi mu Klisto Yesu mu zitsungizioso ayi mu mimvu mioso ! Ameni.

4.1: Minu Polo, ndidi mu nloko mu diambu di Pfumu ndikululeba, ludiatila mu khadulu yifuanikini ayi mbila yoyo kalutedila.
4.2: Bika luba batu bazebi kukikulula ; badi nlembami ayi mvibudulu. Bika, mu luzolo, kadika mutu kazaba kanga ntima mu diambu di ndiandi.
4.3: Lunuana ngolo mu keba kithuadi mu Pheve Yinlongo, mu nzila yi ndembama.
4.4: Nitu yidi yimosi kaka ayi Pheve yidi yimosi kaka. Bobuawu Nzambi wulutela ku diana dimosi.
4.5: Pfumu yidi yimosi kaka, minu kidi kimosi kaka ayi mbotokolo yidi yimosi kaka.
4.6: Nzambi widi wumosi kaka, niandi dise di babo, wunyadilanga batu boso, wunsalanga mu babo ayi widi mu babo.
4.7: Vayi kadika mutu mu beto wutambula nlemvo boso bubela dikaba di Klisto.
4.8: Diawu katubila :
4.9: Vayi diambu diadi : wukuma ku Diyilu buevi dinsundula e ? Dinsundula wutuama kuluka kuna tsi ntoto.
4.10: Mutu wowo wukuluka, niandi kuandi wukuma ku yilu vioka diyilu mu diambu kawesa bima bioso.
4.11: Bila niandi wuvana dikaba kuidi bankaka mu ba bamvuala, bankakamimbikudi, bankaka minsamuni mi Nsamu Wumboti, bankaka mimvungi4.11 Minsekudi minkaka misonika pasitele va buangu ki Mvungi. ayi bankaka minlongi.
4.12: Wuvanga buawu mu diambu di fuanisa banlongo mu sala kisalu kiawu ayi mu diambu di thungulu yi nitu yi Klisto ;
4.13: nate beto boso tuela tula mu kithuadi kimosi mu minu ayi mu zaba bumboti Muana Nzambi ayi mu tula mu tezo ki mutu wuyunduka ; mutu wowo wudedikini mu khudulu yiduka yi Klisto.
4.14: Buna tulendi buela ba bana balezi ko, bobo bannatungu ayi bandiengosongo kuidi yoso-yoso pheve yi malongi meti singimina mu luvunulu batu ayi mu diela diawu di mbimbi di sadila zinzila zimbimbi mu diambu di zimbisa batu.
4.15: Vayi beto zingilanga boso buididi mu luzolo, buna tuela yunduka mu mamo nate kuidi Klisto ; niandi ntu wu Dibundu.
4.16: Mu niandi nitu yimvimba yidi yiyikakana ayi yibundana bumboti mu madikulu madi mu nitu. Buna kadika nama bu kieti sala kisalu kiandi mu bufuana, nitu yimvimba yilembo yunduka ayi yilembo tungu yawu veka mu luzolo.
4.17: Tala diambu ndikulukamba ayi ndibuela vutudila mu Pfumu ti : lubika buela diatila banga Bapakanu, banlandakananga mayindu mawu ma buvungisi
4.18: ayi diela diawu didi mu tombi. Diawu badidi banzenza mu luzingu lu Nzambi mu diambu di buvulu buidi mu bawu, buntotukilanga mu mintimamiawu midi banga matadi.
4.19: Bazimbisa mambu moso momo ma kimutu ; bakiyekula mu vanganga mambuma tsoni mu diambu bavanga mambu moso masumuka ma phila mu phila.
4.20: Vayi buawu ko beno lulongukila Klisto.
4.21: Bila beno lusudika mambu momo batuba mu diambu diandi ayi momo balulonga mu niandi mu phila yi mambu ma kiedika madi mu Yesu.
4.22: Buna lubika nzingulu eno yi khulu, luloza kimutu kieno kikhulu kiokizinzinunu zi luvunu zilembo bivisa.
4.23: Vayi lukituka bamona mu pheve yi diela dieno.
4.24: Bika luvuata mutu wumona, wuvangulu boso bubela mayindu ma Nzambi, mu busonga ayi mu bunlongo bu kiedika.
4.25: Diawu lubika vunasana beno na beno, vayi, bika kadika mutu katuba mambu ma kiedika kuidi ndiandi, bila beto boso tuidi binama bi nitu yimosi.
4.26: Enati fuema lufuemini, lukeba tala luedi vola masumu ; lubika lunda nganzi nate va masika.
4.28: Mutu wowo wubedi yibanga bika kabika buivi ; vayi bika kasala ayi kasala mu mioko miandi kisalu kioki kidi kifuana mu diambu kabakabiobi kafueti kabudila bobo badi basukama.
4.29: Bika mambu mambimbi mabika totukila mu miunu mieno. Vayi momo kaka madi mamboti, mafueni mu tunga minu boso buididi zitsatu ziawu mu diambu mamonisa mamboti kuidi batu bobo balembo wa mawu.
4.30: Lubika monisa pheve Yinlongo yi Nzambi kiadi bila mu Pheve beni Nzambi katudila dimbu kiandi mu beno mu diambu di lumbu ki khudulu.
4.31: Bika mambu ma ndudi, ma kikhesi, ma nganzi ayi ma yamikinina, ma mfingulu mabotuka mu beno va kimosi ayi mambu mamo mambimbi.
4.32: Bika kadika mutu kamonika mutu wumboti kuidi ndiandi ; lumonasanangakiadi, lulemvukilanga badieno banga bobo Nzambi kalulemvukila mu Klisto.

5.1: Sumbu luidi bana bobo Nzambi keta zola, bika lusokudila Tata.
5.2: Ayi ludiatila mu luzolo banga bu tuzodila Klisto bu kakiyekula niandi veka kuidi Nzambi mu diambu dieto banga malasi ma tsudi yi kitoko ayi banga dikaba.
5.3: Kitsuza ayi zitsumukunu zinkaka zi phila mu phila ayi zitsatu mu baka bima bi phila mu phila, zibika monika mu beno boso buididi bufuana kuidi banlongo.
5.4: Ka diambu ko mambu matsoni, mambu ma buvungisi ayi malueya mabika monika mu beno bila masi fuana kuidi beno ko. Vayi bika, mu mambu meno, luzaba vutudilanga Nzambi matondo.
5.5: Bila luzebi kueno ti nkua kitsuza, nsumuki voti mutu wunzolanga baka bima bi phila mu phila (niandi dedikini ayi mutu wunsambilangabitumba) kalendi baka kiuka ko mu kipfumu ki Klisto ayi ki Nzambi.
5.6: Mutu kabika kuluvuna mu mambu ma phamba. Bila mu diambu di mambu ma phila yoyo, nganzi yi Nzambi yeta buila batu bobo bazolanga ko kuntumukina.
5.7: Diawu kadi fubakana ayi batu ba phila yoyo.
5.8: Bila bubedi, beno lubedi tombi vayi buabu lueka kiezila mu Pfumu. Bika ludiatila banga bana bakiezila !
5.9: Bila kiezila kimbutanga mamboti, busonga ayi kiedika.
5.10: Luzaba sobulanga mambu moso meti monisanga Pfumu khini.
5.11: Lubika fubakana mu mavanga ma tombi ; momo mabutanga ko makundivayi bika lutumbudila mawu.
5.12: Bila mambu momo beta vanga mu kitsueki, tsoni madi mu yolukila mawu.
5.13: Vayi kiezila bu kiela totula mambu moso va nganda buna bosi mela monika.
5.14: Kiezila kiawu kintotulanga bima bioso va nganda. Diawu beta tubila ti :
5.15: Diawu, lukeba mu diambu di phila yoyo lufueti diatila mu bufuana. Lubika ba banga bivungisi, vayi bika luba batu badiela.
5.16: Muaki lusadila thangu, bila bilumbu bi tueka bieka bimbimbi.
5.17: Diawu lubika ba banga bivungisi vayi lusudika bumboti boso buididiluzolo lu Pfumu.
5.18: Lubika kolongo malavu, bila mu mawu mueti totukila divunzi vayi bika luba bawala mu Pheve.
5.19: Bika lukikindisanga mu minkunga mikubuku, mu minkunga mi sanisinaayi mu minkunga mi kipheve. Luyimbila ayi lusanisina Pfumu mu mintimamieno mimvimba.
5.20: Mu zithangu zioso, luvutudilanga Nzambi Tata matondo mu mambu mamo mu dizina di Pfumuꞌeto Yesu Klisto.
5.21: Bika kadika mutu kakinzika ndiandi mu diambu di lukinzu luidi yeno mu Klisto.
5.22: Beno baketo, lukinzika babakala beno banga bu lueta kinzikila Pfumu.
5.23: Bila bakala niandi Pfumu yi nketo banga Klisto bu kadidi Pfumu yi Dibundu, nituꞌandi. Niandi Mvulusi wu dibundu beni.
5.24: Sumbu Dibundu didi ku tsi minsua mi Klisto, buawu bobo baketobafueti bedla ku tsi minsua mi babakala bawu mu mambu moso.
5.25: Beno babakala, luzola baketo beno banga Klisto bu kazodila Dibundu, bila wukiyekula mu diambu di Dibundu beni,
5.26: muingi kadikitula di nlongo mu mambu mandi ayi di vedila bu kamanisa ku disukula mu nlangu,
5.27: muingi kadimonisa kuidi niandi veka, Dibundu di kitoko, dikambulu ditona di mvindu, dikambulu minkanza, voti dikambulu diambu di phila yoyi vayi didi dinlongo ayi dikambulu tsembolo.
5.28: Bobuawu babakala bafueti zola baketo bawu banga bu beta zodila zinitu ziawu. Bila bakala diodi dieta zola nketo andi buna weta kukizola niandi veka.
5.29: Bila kuisi ko mutu weta lenda nitu andi. Vayi wukuyidikilanga, wukuyikebanga banga Klisto bu keta kebila Dibundu,
5.30: bila beto tuidi binama bi nitu andi.
5.31: Diawu bakala kela bikila dise diandi ayi ngudi andi mu diambu di bundana ayi nketo andi, ayi, bawu buadi bela kituka nitu yimosi.
5.32: Disuama diodi didi dinneni ; vayi ndinyolukila mu diambu di Klisto ayi dibundu.
5.33: Vayi mu diambu dieno, bika kadika bakala kazola nketo andi bangabu keta kukizodila niandi veka ayi kadika nketo kakinzika bakala diandi.

6.1: Beno bana, lutumukina bambuta beno mu Pfumu bila buawu bufueni.
6.2: Kinzika Dise diaku ayi ngudi aku bila wawu muina wutheti widi ayi tsila. Tala tsila beni yawu yayi :
6.3: muingi wumona mamboti ayi wuzinga buwombo va ntoto.
6.4: Diawu, beno madisa lubika fuemisanga bana beno vayi luba yundudila mu kuba vananga zindongi ayi zindubu mu Pfumu.
6.5: Beno bavika, lutumukina bapfumu zieno zi ntoto mu lukinzu ayi mu lukhuku mu kiedika kioso ki ntima banga kuidi Klisto.
6.6: Lusala kisalu kieno bika sia ti mu thangu zilembo ku lusungi bangati beno luntomba monisa batu khini, vayi banga bavika ba Klisto miomi mieta vanga luzolo lu Nzambi mu mintima mimboti.
6.7: Bika lusala kisalu kieno mu luzolo lumboti banga beno lunsadila Pfumuvayi bika batu.
6.8: Bila luzebi ti Pfumu wela futa kadika mutu mu dioso-dioso diambudi bumboti diela vanga mutu, kaba mvika voti mutu wu kiphuanza.
